column1: # Motion Prompt catalog (en) · 560 elements · https://sadjjk.github.io/motion-prompt-zh/ · columns: id
column3: title
column5: summary

column3: Modal dialog (モーダル)
column5: Clicking "Open" dims the whole page and a small window scales up slightly into the centre; clicking × closes it.

column3: Drawer (Off-canvas) (ドロワー)
column5: Clicking "Menu" slides a tall panel in from the left; clicking outside slides it back.

column3: Bottom sheet (ボトムシート)
column5: A finger taps "View details" and a panel rises from the bottom; dragging its handle down closes it.

column3: Accordion (アコーディオン)
column5: Clicking the first of three headings opens its content and pushes the rows below down; clicking again closes it.

column3: Dropdown (select) (ドロップダウン)
column5: Clicking the field opens four options below it; picking "Nagoya" closes the list and fills the field.

column3: Tooltip (ツールチップ)
column5: Hovering over a "?" icon shows a short note in a dark bubble above it; it disappears when the cursor leaves.

column3: Popover (ポップオーバー)
column5: Clicking "Details" opens a small white panel to its right with a pointer at the button; clicking OK inside closes it.

column3: Toast notification (トースト)
column5: Clicking "Save" slides a dark notice into the bottom-right corner; when its time bar runs out it slides away.

column3: Exit-intent popup (離脱防止ポップアップ)
column5: When the cursor heads out through the top of the page (toward the tabs and close button), the page dims and a "Wait!" popup opens. The × closes it.

column3: Scale in (スケールイン)
column5: Clicking "Open" grows the dialog from 0.95× to full size as it fades in, stopping without overshoot; closing plays the same path in reverse.

column3: Origin-aware animation (起点を意識したアニメーション)
column5: The same menu side by side: on the left it swells from its own centre in mid-air; on the right it grows out of the "More" button and shrinks back into it.

column3: Rubber-banding (ラバーバンド)
column5: Pulling a fully open bottom sheet further up gets heavier and heavier, the sheet lags behind the finger, and on release it snaps back to the edge.

column3: Interruptible animation (中断できるアニメーション)
column5: Tapping again while the drawer is half open does not wait for it to finish; it carries on a little, then turns smoothly and closes.

column3: Drag-and-drop upload (ドラッグ＆ドロップでアップロード)
column5: A file card drops into the dashed upload zone from above; the border turns solid, the progress bar fills, and at 100% it reads "Ready to publish".

column3: Command palette (コマンドパレット)
column5: The ⌘K keys press, the page dims and a panel appears; typing "Settings" narrows the list with matches in blue, the highlight moves down a row and is confirmed.

column3: Cookie banner (Cookie 同意バナー)
column5: A cookie card springs up from the bottom of the page while its cookie icon pops upright from a tilt and wobbles twice; the cursor clicks "Accept all", the button dips and the card slides back down.

column3: Speed dial (スピードダイヤル)
column5: The cursor clicks the blue + at lower right; it turns 135° into × as the page dims, 3 labelled mini buttons pop out above it from the bottom up, and a second click tucks them away in reverse.

column3: Swipe-to-dismiss toast (スワイプで消すトースト)
column5: On a warm grey surface a dark toast, 「已复制链接」, bounces down from the top and the bar along its bottom begins to shrink. The cursor presses and the bar freezes; dragging down shrinks and fades the card while a hint below reads 「下滑关闭」, switching to 「松手即关闭」 past the threshold. On release the card speeds away downward; then 「已保存草稿」 drops in, runs out its timer and lifts away.

column3: Tabs (タブ)
column5: Clicking the tabs "Overview, Pricing, Reviews" in turn slides a blue underline across and swaps the content below.

column3: Carousel (カルーセル)
column5: Each click on the right arrow slides a row of three different images one step to the left, and the dot below moves.

column3: Toggle switch (トグルスイッチ)
column5: The switches on the first two of three setting rows are turned on in turn, then off again.

column3: Segmented control (セグメントコントロール)
column5: Clicking Day, Week or Month slides a blue highlight across and the bar chart below changes height.

column3: Filter chips (チップ)
column5: Clicking the "New" and "Free" chips adds a check mark and turns them blue, and cards that do not match fade out.

column3: Range slider (レンジスライダー)
column5: On a price slider, the left handle is dragged right and the right handle left to narrow the range, then both go back.

column3: Stepper (+/−) (ステッパー)
column5: Pressing + three times raises the number from 1 to 4, and pressing − three times brings it back to 1; the number pops on each press.

column3: Pagination (ページネーション)
column5: Clicking 2 and then 3 in the page numbers moves the blue circle and swaps the list above; finally it goes back to 1.

column3: Before/after slider (ビフォーアフタースライダー)
column5: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.

column3: Drag to reorder (ドラッグで並べ替え)
column5: The first row is grabbed and lifted, dragged down two rows; each row it passes slides up out of the way, and on release it settles into its new place.

column3: OTP input fill (ワンタイムコード入力)
column5: Digits drop into six boxes in turn, the active box glowing blue; when all are filled every box turns blue, the hint switches to "Verified" and the group lifts slightly.

column3: Password strength meter (パスワード強度メーター)
column5: As the dots in the "New password" field grow from 4 to 16, the four bars below light up one at a time and the strength label shifts from red to green.

column3: Pricing toggle (料金プラン切り替え)
column5: The cursor clicks Yearly: the knob slides over, the three prices roll down card by card and the recommended middle card grows with a blue outline; later it switches back to Monthly.

column3: Liquid radio (リキッドラジオボタン)
column5: The cursor picks 4 stacked options in turn; the selection dot flows to each new ring stretched like a droplet and rounds off, and the card on the right updates.

column3: Floating label (フローティングラベル)
column5: The cursor clicks the field: the label shrinks, moves up and turns blue, the underline spreads from the centre and an email address is typed letter by letter; it is then cleared and blurred.

column3: Expanding search (展開する検索ボックス)
column5: The cursor clicks a round magnifier button; it widens to the left into a search field with its right edge fixed, a placeholder appears, a query is typed, and clearing it with × folds it back.

column3: Swipe to delete (スワイプで削除)
column5: A finger drags the second row left to uncover a red "Delete" area; on release the row slides out, its height collapses and the rows below move up, then the row returns.

column3: Selectable cards (複数選択カード)
column5: The cursor picks 3 of 4 cards in turn; each gains a blue outline and check, a bar springs up from the bottom and its count rolls up, and "Clear" deselects all and drops the bar.

column3: Shake on error (エラー時のシェイク)
column5: Six dots are typed into the password field and "Log in" is pressed; the field shakes, its border turns red and a red error message drops in below.

column3: Animated checkbox (アニメーションチェックボックス)
column5: The cursor ticks 3 boxes in turn; each squashes and bounces, fills blue as a white check draws in, and its text is struck through and greyed, then "Clear" resets them.

column3: Tag input (タグ入力)
column5: Two words are typed one after another and each pops out as a pill tag on Enter; then the cursor clicks × twice and the tags shrink away as the rest closes up.

column3: Comet-trail dial (光の尾を引くダイヤル)
column5: A white ceramic knob sits in a ring of ticks on a warm grey panel, with the volume number on the right. The cursor grabs and turns it: a blue dot travels inside the ring with a comet tail, passed ticks flash and fade, and the number and level bar climb. On release the tail shrinks and the number pops, then the knob springs back on its own with a slight overshoot.

column3: Wake bar slider (波が尾を引くスライダー)
column5: Thin bars line a white plastic-style base, blue to the left of the value and grey to the right. The cursor presses and drags slowly, raising a small bump; then it flicks back and forth and a tall wave trails behind it. When the cursor stops the wave settles, and after release the value eases back.

column3: Bell notification toggle (ベル付き通知トグル)
column5: A raised white pill button shows a gold bell on the left and the label 「开启通知」 on the right. The cursor clicks: the pill turns blue and narrows, the label slides up into 「已开启」, the bell swings and sound arcs spread out. A second click turns it white again, a slash cuts across the bell with a small shake, and the slash fades to restore the first frame.

column3: Hamburger menu (ハンバーガーメニュー)
column5: Clicking the three-line icon at the header's right turns it into ×, and a menu drops down from under the header; clicking again closes it.

column3: Breadcrumbs (パンくずリスト)
column5: Clicking "Courses" in the breadcrumbs goes up to the list page; clicking a card there returns to the detail page.

column3: Mega menu (メガメニュー)
column5: Hovering over "Products" in the header drops a full-width panel with three columns of links and an image; it closes when the cursor leaves.

column3: Step indicator (ステップインジケーター)
column5: Each click on "Next" turns the next of four step circles into a check and extends the blue line to the following step.

column3: 3D ring carousel (3D リングカルーセル)
column5: 8 cards in a ring turn slowly, larger and brighter in front, smaller and darker behind; partway through a finger drags right to spin the ring.

column3: Collapsible sidebar (折りたたみサイドバー)
column5: The cursor clicks the button at the foot of the sidebar; it narrows to its icons as the labels fade, the stat cards and chart on the right widen, and a second click later restores it.

column3: Dock magnification (Dock 拡大)
column5: As the cursor sweeps across a dock of 7 icons, the nearby icons swell into a smooth peak that pushes the neighbours aside and travels with the cursor.

column3: Tree menu (ツリーメニュー)
column5: A white side nav has a vertical trunk on the left, with each item joined by a rounded branch. When the cursor clicks 'Products', the items below are pushed down and three child branches grow one by one with a glowing tip as the children fade in. Clicking 'Cases' sends a light along the path from the trunk to it and the item turns orange; a final click on 'Products' folds it all back.

column3: Skeleton screen (スケルトン)
column5: Clicking reload turns the list into grey blocks of the same shape with a sweeping shine; the content returns when loading ends.

column3: Badge (バッジ)
column5: Each time a notification arrives, the blue dot on the bell in the header counts up 1, 2, 3; clicking the bell clears it.

column3: Empty state (エンプティステート)
column5: Deleting the two list rows with their trash icons brings up an empty-box drawing, "Nothing here yet" and an "Add" button.

column3: Keyboard shortcut press (ショートカットキーの点灯)
column5: On a dark keyboard plate Ctrl, Shift and P press down and glow amber in turn; the caption builds up, the plate gives a small pulse and the text changes to "Queued".

column3: Code diff highlight (コード差分のハイライト)
column5: In a dark five-line editor the context lines brighten, then a red removed line and a green added line slide in from the left, and the added line's background deepens once before settling.

column3: Deploy pipeline (デプロイパイプライン)
column5: Four stage cards on a dark background run left to right; each one that passes glows green at its border and dot, a line extends to the next, and the final Deploy card reads "Live".

column3: Pull to refresh (プルトゥリフレッシュ)
column5: In a phone screen a finger drags the list down; it follows with resistance as the arrow at the top turns, then on release the icon spins, the list springs back and a new message slides in at the top.

column3: Marching ants selection (マーチングアンツ)
column5: In a design-tool canvas, the blue dashed box around a layer keeps crawling in one direction, and the size label below changes as the box grows and shrinks.

column3: Parallax scrolling (パララックススクロール)
column5: As the page scrolls down, the headline moves up normally while the sky and sun, far hills and near hills move more slowly.

column3: Fade-in on scroll (スクロールでフェードイン)
column5: As the page scrolls, the heading, the cards and the body text each rise into place and fade in when they enter the view.

column3: Sticky header (追従ヘッダー)
column5: The announcement strip scrolls away, but the header below it stops at the top edge and the content scrolls underneath.

column3: Pinning (ピン留め)
column5: A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.

column3: Horizontal scroll (横スクロール)
column5: As the page scrolls down, the section holds still and four numbered work cards travel to the left.

column3: Scroll snap (スクロールスナップ)
column5: After a small scroll, the page carries itself the rest of the way until the next section's top lines up with the top of the view.

column3: Scroll progress bar (スクロールプログレスバー)
column5: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.

column3: Highlighter animation (マーカーアニメーション)
column5: As the copy scrolls into view, a yellow highlighter stroke is drawn left to right across the lower half of the key words.

column3: Smooth scroll (スムーススクロール)
column5: Clicking "Pricing" in the menu glides the page down to the pricing section; the up arrow at the bottom right glides it back to the top.

column3: Shrinking sticky card stack (カードの積み重ね固定)
column5: Gradient cards scroll up and pin near the top; each time the next card slides over, the ones beneath shrink and darken into steps.

column3: Scroll-filled sentence (スクロールで塗られる文)
column5: As you scroll, the pale sentence darkens word by word from the start, key words light up purple, and a button springs up at the end.

column3: Per-section background shift (セクションごとの背景切り替え)
column5: Scrolling melts the background into the next flavour colour, the central can tilts as it swaps colour and label, and the copy slides up.

column3: Velocity-lean list (速度で傾くリスト)
column5: A fast flick skews and slightly stretches the column of cards, which springs straight again on stopping; slow scrolling barely tilts it.

column3: Rolling chapter numbers (回転する章番号)
column5: As the body scrolls, the big chapter number on the left rolls to the next like a digit strip, the chapter name slides in, and a ring fills.

column3: Drum time picker (ドラム式時刻ピッカー)
column5: Dragging a wheel rolls the numbers to rest on the centre line, far values tip away and fade, and the alarm time and countdown update.

column3: Tilt-to-flat product screen (傾きから正面へのスクリーン)
column5: Scrolling lifts the backward-tilted product window upright as it grows and its shadow deepens; once flat, the chart bars rise in sequence.

column3: Timeline draw (タイムラインの描画)
column5: As scrolling progresses, a thin line on the left grows from top to bottom; each node it reaches fills in and its week, title and note slide in from the left. Scrolling back shrinks the line and hides the steps.

column3: Back-to-top progress ring (進捗リング付きトップへ戻る)
column5: As the article scrolls down, a round button appears at the lower right and its outer arc grows with the amount read. The pointer clicks it, the page glides back to the top and the button shrinks away.

column3: Scroll zoom to full (スクロールで全画面ズーム)
column5: A small rounded image sits in the middle of a dark screen. As scrolling progresses it grows to fill the frame, its corners turn square and the scene inside eases back; late in the scroll a title rises in from below, and scrolling back reverses it all.

column3: Progressive edge blur (プログレッシブブラー)
column5: On a navy page, an article column with a headline, body text, a lake photo card and a stats card scrolls up at a steady pace and loops seamlessly. As the content nears the top or bottom edge it blurs and fades in stages, as if sinking into fog; under the floating glass nav bar at the top, the most heavily blurred content shows through as soft blocks of colour.

column3: Preloader (ローディング画面)
column5: On a navy screen the number under the logo counts from 0% to 100%; then the screen lifts away and the page underneath fades in.

column3: Lazy loading (遅延読み込み)
column5: As grey placeholders scroll into view, a spinner turns in each, and the images fade in as they arrive. The top row is loaded from the start.

column3: Infinite scroll (無限スクロール)
column5: Scrolling down to the end of the list brings up a spinner, then three new items are added so reading can go on.

column3: Page transition (ページ遷移アニメーション)
column5: Clicking a card in the work list sweeps an orange panel across from the left; the URL changes and the panel exits to the right on the detail page. "Back to list" returns the same way.

column3: Shared element transition (共有要素トランジション)
column5: A list thumbnail moves and expands straight into the detail page's large image while everything else cross-fades; going back shrinks it along the same path.

column3: Direction-aware transition (方向に合わせたトランジション)
column5: Moving forward through the onboarding slides content to the left; going back slides it to the right, with the page dots following.

column3: Layout animation (レイアウトアニメーション)
column5: Deleting the second card makes the following cards glide into the gap, with the wrapping card moving up diagonally; undo sends each back to its place.

column3: Slice transition (スライストランジション)
column5: The picture in the frame splits into 6 vertical strips that slide away left to right, up, down, up…, revealing the next picture; the same move later brings the first back.

column3: Circle reveal transition (円形リビール)
column5: As scrolling progresses, a dark chapter 2 grows as a circle from the centre of the light chapter 1 until it covers the card; the first title shrinks away while the second settles from larger to normal size, and scrolling back shrinks the circle.

column3: Marquee (マーキー)
column5: Inside a navy band, large service names separated by orange dots keep moving to the left without a gap.

column3: Animated gradient (グラデーションアニメーション)
column5: Behind the headline, soft patches of orange, light orange, blue and light blue drift in circles and keep blending differently.

column3: Floating animation (ふわふわアニメーション)
column5: Next to the headline, a phone, a heart badge and a rating chip each bob gently out of step, and the shadow under the phone grows and shrinks.

column3: Grid-beam background (グリッドビーム背景)
column5: Coloured beams with fading tails streak across a faint dark grid, and the grid lights up indigo only around the pointer.

column3: Warp starfield (ワープする星空)
column5: Stars drift out from the centre; holding the button accelerates them into blue streaks with a glowing core, and releasing eases back to cruise.

column3: Constellation mesh (星座のようなメッシュ)
column5: Dots drift on a dark field joined by faint lines; the pointer pulls nearby dots in with yellow links, and a click sprays out new dots.

column3: Dot grid ripple (ドットグリッドの波紋)
column5: As the pointer crosses the calm grey grid, rings spread from its trail; dots on the wave swell, lift and shift from blue-violet to teal.

column3: Particles that form words (粒子が文字になる)
column5: On a dark violet background, glowing dots form HELLO, part around the passing pointer, and burst apart on each click to re-form as NICE, then LUCIAN.

column3: Sunburst rays (サンバースト)
column5: On a dark background, golden rays fan out from behind a centred headline and turn slowly, fading into the background towards the edges.

column3: Flow field (フローフィールド)
column5: Thin purple and blue lines stream across a dark background like wind or water and fade away; where the cursor passes, the flow curls into a swirl.

column3: Metaballs (メタボール)
column5: On a dark background, purple-to-blue balls drift slowly, grow a neck and join when they meet, then snap apart into separate balls again.

column3: Organic blob (オーガニックブロブ)
column5: In the middle of a dark background, a pink-to-purple blob keeps rippling its outline while a faint shadow behind it changes shape to a different rhythm.

column3: Aurora gradient (オーロラグラデーション)
column5: On a dark background, large green, blue, purple and pink glows drift on separate paths and overlap, with a greeting headline on top.

column3: Flowing gradient stroke (フローグラデーションライン)
column5: An infinity-shaped line sits on a dark background; blue-to-pink colour keeps flowing along it while a glowing white spark with a tail laps the line.

column3: Wavy lines (うねる線)
column5: On a dark ground 26 thin horizontal lines undulate like contour lines, with a brighter thicker line every few; as a simulated cursor passes left to right, the nearby lines lift softly and settle back.

column3: Magnetic button (マグネティックボタン)
column5: As the cursor comes near, the button is drawn toward it and follows; when the cursor leaves, the button wobbles back to its place.

column3: Ripple effect (リップルエフェクト)
column5: Each click sends a white circle out from the click point to fill the button, then it fades away.

column3: Press / tap feedback (押したときの縮み)
column5: Two identical buttons: the left one does nothing when pressed; the right one shrinks a little with a tighter shadow and recovers on release.

column3: Hold to confirm (長押しで確定)
column5: The first hold is released early and the fill drains back; the second lasts the full 1.2 s, the file card disappears and the button reads "Deleted".

column3: Rotating gradient border (回転グラデーションボーダー)
column5: A multicolour gradient circles the border of a button on a dark page; when the cursor hovers, it spins faster and a glow appears around it.

column3: Jelly button (ゼリーボタン)
column5: The cursor presses the button twice; each time it squashes wide, stretches tall and wobbles back, while the caption counts the items added.

column3: Rolling text button (ローリングテキストボタン)
column5: When the cursor lands, the label's characters roll up one after another and the same characters come up from below; the button flips from white to ink and the round arrow turns to point up-right.

column3: Border draw button (ボーダードローボタン)
column5: When the cursor lands, an orange line runs clockwise from the top-left corner around the thinly outlined button and the label turns orange; when it leaves, the line retracts in reverse.

column3: Icon slide button (アイコンスライドボタン)
column5: When the cursor lands, the arrow on the right of the button slides out and fades while a matching arrow slides in from outside the left edge, and the label moves right to make room.

column3: Expanding button (エキスパンディングボタン)
column5: When the cursor lands on a round plus button, it stretches to the right into a pill, the plus turns and the label 'New project' appears; it folds back into a circle when the cursor leaves.

column3: Direction-aware fill button (方向認識フィルボタン)
column5: On a dark page the cursor enters an outlined button from the lower left and an orange circle spreads from that point to fill it; when the cursor leaves upward, the circle shrinks away toward the exit point.

column3: Neon glow button (ネオングローボタン)
column5: On a dark background, a cyan neon-outlined button pulses gently; when the pointer arrives it fills, the label inverts and a large glow appears, then it returns to breathing when the pointer leaves.

column3: Hover lift (ホバーで浮き上がる)
column5: Only the card under the cursor lifts slightly and its shadow spreads; it settles back when the cursor leaves.

column3: Image zoom on hover (ホバーで画像ズーム)
column5: The photo under the cursor slowly enlarges while its frame stays the same size, and shrinks back when the cursor leaves.

column3: Underline animation (下線アニメーション)
column5: Under the link the cursor is on, an orange line grows from the left; when the cursor leaves, the line shrinks away to the right.

column3: Icon micro-animations (アイコンマイクロアニメーション)
column5: As the cursor passes along 4 icons, each tile lights up: the bell swings, the heart fills and pops, the gear turns and the envelope flap opens.

column3: Focus dim siblings (フォーカス＆ディム)
column5: As the cursor moves over 4 cards, only the pointed card lifts and grows a little while the others turn faint, greyish and smaller.

column3: Bento grid expand (ベントーグリッド展開)
column5: In a 3×2 bento grid, the cursor rests on the top-left and then the bottom-right tile; each time that tile grows with a larger title while the others shrink to make room.

column3: Expanding panels (エキスパンディングパネル)
column5: Among 5 tall image panels, the 2nd and then the 4th widen as the cursor rests on them while the others narrow, and a title appears at the lower left of the wide panel.

column3: Saturate on hover (ホバーで彩度を戻す)
column5: Of 4 muted, dim pictures, the 1st and then the 3rd come back to vivid colour and zoom slightly as the cursor rests on them, with a name tag rising from the bottom.

column3: Cursor follower (マウスストーカー)
column5: As the cursor moves around the page, an orange circle follows it a little behind.

column3: Cursor-lit borders (カーソルで光る枠線)
column5: The pointer sweeps in a wave across four dark cards; borders near it glow from violet to blue, then dim slowly once it passes.

column3: Hover-follow preview (ホバーで追う画像プレビュー)
column5: The pointer moves down a dark list of project names; the hovered row shifts right and brightens while a trailing image tilts and slides to the next project.

column3: Cursor photo trail (カーソルの写真の軌跡)
column5: As the pointer crosses a large heading, white-framed photos pop in at random angles and sink away; a click fans out 5 photos at once.

column3: Direction-aware overlay (入った方向からのオーバーレイ)
column5: The pointer crosses a 3 × 3 thumbnail grid from many directions; a dark caption panel slides in from the entry edge and out the exit edge.

column3: Cursor lens reveal (カーソルのレンズで現れる文)
column5: A round lens chases the pointer springily over a two-line headline, revealing another sentence on dark ground; a click expands it to full size, another shrinks it back.

column3: Swipeable card stack (スワイプするカードの山)
column5: The pointer drags the top card right with a tilt, flings it away with a Save stamp, swipes the next one left to Skip, and finally both fly back.

column3: Tilt parallax image (3Dチルト視差画像)
column5: As the cursor moves over a sunset mountain image, it tilts and enlarges slightly, the sky, sun and ridges shift by different amounts, and a caption slides up from the bottom.

column3: Following eyes (目で追うキャラクター)
column5: Inside the big white eyes of a purple mascot, the black pupils follow the cursor, moving closer to the rim the farther away it is; now and then both eyes blink together.

column3: Light source shadow (光源のロングシャドウ)
column5: On a dark background a small warm light circles a big headline. The long shadow behind the headline always points away from the light and swings round as it moves; when the light goes out the shadow folds back under the text.

column3: Blend difference cursor (反転ブレンドカーソル)
column5: The cursor becomes a white circle that inverts the text and background beneath it. Over the big headline the circle grows to cover more letters, and shrinks again when it leaves.

column3: Contextual cursor (コンテキストカーソル)
column5: 3 work cards sit in a row. The cursor is a small dot; over a card it springs into a large dark circle showing an icon and an action word (Play, View, Drag), then shrinks back to a dot when it leaves.

column3: Crosshair cursor (クロスヘアカーソル)
column5: On a dark background with a faint grid, a horizontal and a vertical line span the frame and cross at the cursor. A small ring marks the crossing, and a label at the lower right updates the coordinates as it moves.

column3: Page flip (ページめくり)
column5: The cursor clicks the right page of an open book twice; each time a leaf narrows over the spine, flips and lands on the left; a final click on the left page turns both leaves back.

column3: Folding card (二つ折りカード)
column5: The cursor clicks the navy cover; it swings open on its left edge to show the inner left half while 3 lines on the right fade up in turn, and it closes again at the end.

column3: Card deal (カードディール)
column5: Pressing Deal sends 5 cards up from the bottom in turn into a fan; later, Collect sends them back down starting with the last card.

column3: Photo stack shuffle (フォトスタックシャッフル)
column5: Each time the cursor clicks a pile of 4 tilted polaroids, the top one slides out to the right and goes to the bottom while the rest move up a place.

column3: Holographic card (ホログラムカード)
column5: As the cursor moves over a card on a dark background, the card tilts in 3D, rainbow foil streams across its face and a soft glare follows; it straightens when the cursor leaves.

column3: Scratch reveal (スクラッチ)
column5: Over a coupon covered by a silver coating, the cursor holds and zigzags side to side; its path rubs the coating away to show the free-shipping coupon, and the rest then fades.

column3: Memory match (神経衰弱カード)
column5: A pointer flips 2 of 8 face-down cards; the pictures differ, so after a pause both flip back. It then flips the 2 matching moons, which turn accent-coloured and bounce, and the progress reads 1/4.

column3: Tear-off ticket stub (チケットのもぎり)
column5: The cursor grabs the stub at the right end of a papery concert ticket and pulls down. The perforation tears from top to bottom with a fibrous edge, the stub spins out of frame, the main ticket springs back and a red 'checked' stamp lands on it; once the stamp fades, the stub reappears in place.

column3: Shredder delete (シュレッダーで削除)
column5: A file list sits on the left and a graphite shredder on the right. The cursor picks up the PDF row and carries it in an arc to the slot; once released, the card is sucked in, the machine shakes, its light blinks orange and thin strips curl down behind the bin window. The rows below slide up to fill the gap, then everything resets.

column3: Folder pop-out cards (フォルダーからカードが飛び出す)
column5: An orange 3D folder sits on a desk. When the cursor hovers, the front flap tips forward and three cards (a color palette, a sketch sticky note and a quote card) pop out one after another to the left, top and right, floating at a slight tilt. When the cursor leaves, they return in reverse order and the flap closes with a small bounce.

column3: Gooey morph menu (リキッド展開メニュー)
column5: A cursor clicks the +; three circles stretch out of the white liquid, their necks thin and break, and icons appear. A second click draws them back into one.

column3: Gooey trail (リキッドの尾)
column5: A white indicator moves between three options; the faster it goes, the more it stretches and the bigger the droplet clinging behind it.

column3: Gooey bend (リキッドのしなり)
column5: A white card is dragged side to side; the faster it moves, the more its sides bow backwards, straightening as it slows.

column3: Payment ring & check (支払いリングとチェック)
column5: The pay button shrinks into a circle on click, a ring fills while 3 steps light up, it turns green with a check, and a receipt bounces up from below.

column3: Heart burst like (ハートがはじける「いいね」)
column5: On click the heart squashes then pops, filling red as a ring and coloured dots burst out; the count rolls from 842 to 843 and back on a second click.

column3: Rolling digits (桁ごとに回る数字)
column5: Each update of a large live-visitor number rolls only the changed digits with a slight overshoot, while the trend line beside it shifts one step left.

column3: Add to cart fly (カートに飛び込む)
column5: When the product card button is pressed, the cup image arcs to the cart in the top right while shrinking; the cart bounces and the badge changes from 2 to 3.

column3: Send plane button (紙飛行機の送信ボタン)
column5: The purple button dips and recovers, its label slides off to the right, and the paper plane winds back before shooting off to the top right; the button turns green with a sent label sliding in, then everything returns and the plane flies back.

column3: Star rating (星評価)
column5: Hovering the 2nd star tints 2 stars and shows a label; clicking the 4th then fills stars 1 to 4 in gold from left to right with a bounce and a "very good" label floats up.

column3: Slide to confirm (スライドして確定)
column5: The capsule knob is first dragged partway and released, bouncing back; the second drag reaches the end, the whole track fills green and the label changes to confirmed. A shine sweeps the hint text.

column3: Chat message pop (チャットメッセージの出現)
column5: The other person's bubble pops in on the left with 3 dots bouncing in turn; it widens into a text message, and an accent-coloured reply pops out on the right. Both then drift up and fade.

column3: Badge unlock (バッジ解除)
column5: A hexagon outline draws in one stroke and fills with gold; a large rotated star shrinks and stamps into the centre. Short rays shoot outward as the badge gives a small bounce, and the achievement name and 'Unlocked' rise in below.

column3: Copy feedback (コピー完了のフィードバック)
column5: A pointer presses the copy button beside a command line. The copy icon spins away, a check springs in, the button turns accent-coloured and a 'Copied' tooltip pops up above it; shortly after, everything returns.

column3: Spinner (スピナー)
column5: Clicking "Send" washes the card white and a blue arc spins in the middle; when finished it changes to a check and fades.

column3: Install progress on icon (アイコン上のインストール進捗)
column5: A dark wedge over a gradient app icon sweeps away clockwise, pauses and resumes on taps, and on completion the icon bounces and an Open button pops in.

column3: Indeterminate to determinate (不確定から確定への進捗)
column5: On a deploy card, streaks sliding through the bar give way to the same bar filling step by step, log lines float in and tick off, and the status pill turns green.

column3: Animated weather icons (アニメーション天気アイコン)
column5: On 4 small cards the sun's rays rotate, a cloud drifts side to side, raindrops fall in turn and a storm cloud's bolt flashes now and then.

column3: Analog clock (アナログ時計)
column5: On a white face with 60 ticks, the hour and minute hands stay at 10:10 while the orange second hand jumps from major tick to major tick, overshooting slightly each time.

column3: Liquid fill icon (リキッドフィルアイコン)
column5: Inside a drop outline on a dark background, 2 crossing wave layers rise from the bottom until the drop is full, while the number on the right climbs from 0% to 100% and reads complete, then everything resets.

column3: Task status icon (タスク状態アイコン)
column5: A three-row task list shows a raised disc with a dashed ring at the start of each row. Row by row the dashes gather into a spinning purple arc; when the arc closes the disc fills green, a check is drawn and the status on the right switches to done. The third row's arc stalls, turns red, shrinks to the centre and becomes a cross that shakes, then every row resets to waiting in turn.

column3: Grid wave loader (グリッド波ローダー)
column5: Two rows of raised white tiles sit in a recessed tray, and a light wave sweeps left to right again and again, lifting each tile it passes, lighting it in colour and dropping it back. Above is the status and percentage, below the current file name and count, and a stopwatch runs on the right. When done all tiles light up at once, slide together into a purple-to-green gradient progress bar with “Done”, then split back into tiles.

column3: Border beam (ボーダービーム)
column5: A rainbow beam, bright at the head and fading at the tail, keeps travelling clockwise around a dark input field.

column3: Line beam (ラインビーム)
column5: Only the bottom edge of a rounded search field lights up, and the light glides from left to right and back.

column3: Inner pulse (インナーパルス)
column5: Inside a pill button, pink, orange and blue glows swell and shrink, and the outline brightens with them.

column3: Outer pulse (アウターパルス)
column5: Layered rainbow rings spread out around a dark input and shrink back, while the field itself stays crisp.

column3: Thinking orb: working (思考オーブ・作業中)
column5: Around a slowly spinning dotted orb, particles with short trails orbit on three tilted paths at different speeds.

column3: Thinking orb: searching (思考オーブ・検索中)
column5: A dotted globe turns while a vertical line of light sweeps over it, brightening the dots it passes.

column3: Thinking orb: listening (思考オーブ・聞き取り中)
column5: Rings of dots swell and shrink one after another from top to bottom, like a wave rolling over the orb.

column3: Thinking orb: connecting (思考オーブ・接続中)
column5: On a turning orb, nodes are joined one link at a time like a constellation, then light packets run along the links before it all fades and restarts.

column3: Thinking orb: composing (思考オーブ・執筆中)
column5: Three bands of dots wrap the orb at different tilts, rippling as they flow, with light running along them.

column3: Collapsible thinking (思考過程の折りたたみ)
column5: Next to the AI avatar a card counts up the thinking time while reasoning steps appear one at a time from below, each new line swept by a purple shine. When thinking ends the title becomes “Thought for 4.8 s” with a chevron, the steps stack upward from the bottom and vanish, the card shrinks and the first line of the answer rises in.

column3: Staged image generation (画像の段階的生成)
column5: A prompt bubble sits on the left and an empty image frame on the right. Soft colour blobs drift inside the frame and settle into the composition, turn into a coarse coloured mosaic, then the squares get finer until a sunset lighthouse scene comes into focus. On completion the card gives a small bounce, a download button pops in and the lighthouse beam swings once, before it all fades back to the empty frame.

column3: Hold-to-talk capsule (長押し録音カプセル)
column5: The pointer presses a round purple mic button, which swells sideways into a dark capsule: a red dot breathes on the left, bars bounce with the voice in the middle and a timer runs on the right. On release the bars flatten from the ends into a single line, the capsule springs back into a round button, and a transcript bubble pops up above and types out its text.

column3: Rolling word cube (単語キューブの回転)
column5: The cube rolls down one face at a time to reveal the next word, the caption below flips with it, and a progress bar fills between rolls.

column3: Circular text badge (円形テキストバッジ)
column5: Text on a ring spins slowly, accelerates when the pointer arrives, and jumps faster on each click as new words fade in letter by letter.

column3: Scatter & reassemble letters (文字の飛散と再集合)
column5: Coloured capital letters fly apart spinning, fall and bounce under gravity, hover briefly, then snap back into the word one by one.

column3: Word-by-word kinetic captions (単語ごとのキネティック字幕)
column5: When playback starts, words bounce up one at a time, key words swell and tilt before landing in yellow, and finished lines fold up and vanish.

column3: Hand-drawn annotations (手描きの注釈)
column5: Each time a style is picked, the old marks rewind away and new red strokes are drawn word by word, each followed by a lighter second pass.

column3: Spoiler sand cover (ネタバレの砂カバー)
column5: Fine grains flicker over part of a chat bubble; a tap scatters them from that point to reveal the words, and 'hide' gathers them back.

column3: Sentence reading focus (読んでいる文のフォーカス)
column5: As the pointer moves between sentences, only that one sharpens while the rest blur and fade, and a purple bar on the left follows and resizes.

column3: Rippling letters (文字のばね波紋)
column5: As the pointer glides left to right, the big letters beneath lift and tint purple, then bounce down; a button sends a wave across them.

column3: Isometric data blocks (アイソメトリックのデータブロック)
column5: Isometric blocks rise from the front with a bounce; hovering greys out all but the bar's row and column and shows its value, and switching metrics re-stacks heights in a wave.

column3: Regrouping bubbles (グループが組み替わるバブル)
column5: A cluster of coloured bubbles jostles apart into 4, then 3 groups as tabs switch, then merges back; labels above each group show budget totals.

column3: Live table insert (新しい行が入るテーブル)
column5: New orders slide into the table with a flash; clicking the amount header makes rows pass each other into a new order, and the time header restores it.

column3: Bar chart race (順位が入れ替わる棒グラフ)
column5: Drink bars grow year by year, overtaking bars slide up to swap ranks and a large year ticks on; dragging the slider back plays the ranking in reverse.

column3: Waffle chart flip (反転するワッフルチャート)
column5: Each age-tab click flips only the cells that change colour in a diagonal wave while the percentages roll; hovering a legend item isolates that mode.

column3: Quarterly bubble motion (四半期ごとに動くバブル)
column5: Behind a large quarter label, app bubbles glide across the chart while changing size, one leaving a dotted trail; dragging fast-forwards or rewinds time.

column3: Line chart draw (折れ線グラフの描画)
column5: Over faint gridlines the line grows from left to right, points pop in turn, a gradient area fades in below and a growth label floats up at the end.

column3: Donut chart segments (ドーナツグラフの分割描画)
column5: From the top, the first arc draws clockwise and each next arc continues from where the last ended until the ring closes; the total appears in the centre and the legend slides in on the right.

column3: Stat cards (統計カード)
column5: 3 data cards float up one after another. Each number counts from 0 to its target, a small sparkline draws in from the left, and the growth tag fades in at the top right.

column3: Table crosshair highlight (表のクロスハイライト)
column5: A pointer moves across a 4 × 4 table of numbers. The whole row and column of the cell it rests on tint softly into a cross, and that cell fills with the accent colour with its number bold, white and larger. Leaving the table clears it.

column3: Liquid glass lens (リキッドグラスレンズ)
column5: Over a dark grid with a large headline and 6 colour chips, a capsule-shaped glass lens glides right, pauses, then glides back. The middle of the lens is clear, while content near the rim is pulled inwards and bent, with red and blue fringes along the edge; an arched highlight sits on top and a soft shadow falls outside.

column3: Hide-on-scroll header (スクロールで隠れるヘッダー)
column5: Scrolling down slides the header up out of view; scrolling back up a little slides it back in.

column3: Loading button (ローディングボタン)
column5: After the click, the subscribe button shrinks into a spinning circle, then widens in green with a check and "Subscribed", and resets.

column3: Ball pit (ボールプール)
column5: 26 balls drop into a dark frame and pile up; the cursor sweeps along the floor from left to right shoving them aside, a click in the middle blasts them apart, they fall back, and the layer fades out.

column3: Sticker peel (ステッカーはがし)
column5: The cursor pinches the bottom-right corner of an orange sticker on a dotted backing and pulls it up-left; the crease advances as the back folds over, and on release it springs back flat with a wobble.

column3: Pressure type (プレッシャー文字)
column5: The cursor sweeps across the capitals PRESSURE three times; letters near it swell and darken while the rest stay narrow and grey.

column3: Magnet lines (マグネットライン)
column5: 24×9 short lines on a dark background turn to point at the cursor and glow green nearby; a click in the middle makes them flip half a turn in an outward wave, and they return to swaying when the cursor leaves.

column3: Lens dot field (レンズドットフィールド)
column5: A lens of radius 72 px follows the cursor over a gradient dot grid with 13 px spacing; first it magnifies the dots inside, then it twists them into a swirl.

column3: Letter glitch (レターグリッチ)
column5: 49×13 monospace characters flicker and swap at random in 4 greens and violets; the area around the cursor scrambles white, and a click tears nearby rows sideways with a magenta flash.

column3: Cursor grid (カーソル点灯グリッド)
column5: The cursor moves over a 26 px grid; cells it crosses light up and fade into a trail, and a click sends a ring of lit cells outward.

column3: Contour terrain (等高線地形)
column5: A perspective landscape of 13 blue contour levels rolls; the ground swells into a hill under the cursor, and a click sends a white ring of light across the lines.

column3: Shape waves (シェイプウェーブ)
column5: Diagonal waves roll across 28×11 circles, triangles and squares; at the crests the shapes grow and glow from gold to pink, and in the troughs they shrink and darken.

column3: ASCII glow (ASCII グロー)
column5: Three coloured glows drift across a 77×17 grid of monospace characters, brightness shown by how dense each character is, and characters scramble and glow white around the cursor.

column3: Dither waves (ディザウェーブ)
column5: Waves roll in four colours of pixels, indigo, violet, coral and cream, with dithered dot patterns at the edges, and a bright tail stretches behind the cursor and fades.

column3: Pixel paint swirl (ピクセル絵の具の渦)
column5: Chunky four-colour pixel paint swirls around the centre; the cursor twists the paint as it passes, and a click opens a whirlpool that then fades.

column3: Gradient blinds (グラデーションブラインド)
column5: 18 vertical blinds sway gently; as the cursor's spotlight moves, the slats tilt toward it and glow whitish where the light falls.

column3: Highway light trails (夜のハイウェイ光跡)
column5: Red and white light trails stream along a night road; when the cursor holds from 2.3 s the speed climbs, trails stretch, the view widens and tints violet, and on release it drops back to cruising.

column3: Tilted tile wall (傾いたタイルの壁)
column5: Five rows of cards tilted −12° drift in alternating directions; as the cursor moves the rows shift by depth-like amounts, and the card right under it lifts and glows.

column3: Cube field (キューブフィールド)
column5: Twelve by four cubes sit at an angle; those near the cursor tilt toward it, and a click at 3.2 s sends a wave that spins them one by one.

column3: Ribbon cursor (リボンカーソル)
column5: The cursor crosses along a wavy line and four coloured ribbons follow on springs, swinging outward at each bend.

column3: Target cursor (ターゲットカーソル)
column5: The cursor moves to a nav pill, a button and a card in turn; each time the four brackets bounce onto its outline, and it clicks the button at 2.9 s.

column3: Dodge field (よけるアイコン)
column5: Seven by three icons sit on a light page; as the cursor snakes through the three rows nearby icons move aside, then return once it passes.

column3: Halftone reveal (網点リビール)
column5: The cursor moves over dark halftone dots and a sunset mountain picture appears in dots along its path; a click at 4.0 s reveals the whole picture before it fades.

column3: Pixel swap (ピクセルスワップ)
column5: When the cursor enters the card from the left at 1.0 s a pixel wave turns day into night; when it leaves at the bottom right at 3.4 s a reverse wave turns it back.

column3: Electric border (電流ボーダー)
column5: On a dark background, a rounded card's edge is 2 trembling electric arcs; as the cursor circles the card the nearest stretch thrashes and the whole ring brightens while it touches.

column3: Bounce cards (バウンスカード)
column5: 5 cards bounce in as a fan; the cursor stops on each in turn from left to right, the hovered card straightens and comes forward while its neighbours slide out, and finally all shrink away.

column3: Lanyard badge (ストラップ付き名札)
column5: The badge hangs with a gentle sway; at 1.2 s the cursor grabs it and pulls it up to the right, and on release at 2.6 s it swings wide, the strap springs back, and the motion dies down.

column3: Curved input (カーブ入力欄)
column5: A flat search field bends into an arc; on click a focus ring appears and letters are typed one by one along the arc; pressing send makes the text flow along the arc and vanish, and the placeholder returns.

column3: Scrub field (ドラッグ調整フィールド)
column5: On a dark background the cursor presses the Opacity field and drags right; once the value hits 100 the right edge stretches, then springs back on release. Next it drags left past 0, and the left edge stretches and returns.

column3: Arc gallery (アーチギャラリー)
column5: On a dark background, curved cards sit along an arc; the cursor drags left and lets go, the cards settle into the nearest slot, then it drags right back to the original order.

column3: Flowing menu (フローイングメニュー)
column5: On a dark background, the cursor runs down a 4-row menu and a band slides into each row from above with the name scrolling; returning up to the 3rd row, the band comes in from below.

column3: Fuse undo (導火線の取り消し)
column5: The cursor presses a file row's delete button and the row slides away to the right; a dark toast appears below and the undo button's outline burns along with sparks. Pressing undo midway puts the flame out with a puff of smoke, and the file row comes back.

column3: Slosh gauge (揺れる液面ゲージ)
column5: In a glass jar on a dark background, the liquid chases each new target, overshoots a little and its surface tilts and sloshes. Finally it hits 100% and splashes, and the number on the right turns teal.

column3: Tool call chip (ツール呼び出しチップ)
column5: On a light background, the search_docs chip fills from the left and turns into a green check; the next chip, run_query, turns red partway, shakes side to side and shows failed.

column3: Pop-in (ポップイン)
column5: An app icon pops in with a bounce, then a notification badge pops in a moment later.

column3: Stagger (スタガー)
column5: Chart bars rise one after another from the left, each slightly delayed.

column3: Mask reveal (マスクリビール)
column5: Headline text slides out from behind an invisible edge marked by a single line.

column3: Easing (イージング)
column5: Two squares cover the same distance in the same time: the top one at constant speed, the bottom one eased.

column3: Overshoot (オーバーシュート)
column5: A gauge needle swings past its target, comes back and settles.

column3: Squash & stretch (スクワッシュ＆ストレッチ)
column5: A bouncing character squashes on landing and stretches as it takes off.

column3: Anticipation (アンティシペーション)
column5: A square character pulls back against its direction of travel, squashes to wind up, then shoots forward.

column3: Follow-through (フォロースルー)
column5: A round character slides in and stops suddenly; only the flag on its head and its tail keep swinging, then settle.

column3: Bounce (バウンス)
column5: A ball drops and bounces lower each time until it comes to rest.

column3: Liquid motion (リキッドモーション)
column5: A blob stretches out, breaks into drops and merges back into one.

column3: Motion trail (モーショントレイル)
column5: A ball moving in a figure eight leaves a fading trail of copies behind it.

column3: Parallax (パララックス)
column5: A landscape pans sideways; near layers move more and far layers move less, creating depth.

column3: Wiggle (ウィグル)
column5: A bell keeps jittering irregularly: not one hit, but a small shake that never stops.

column3: Pulse (パルス)
column5: A heart throbs like a heartbeat, a double beat each time, with rings spreading out.

column3: Motion path (モーションパス)
column5: A paper plane follows a dotted path, turning as it goes and looping the loop on the way.

column3: Ping-pong loop (ピンポンループ)
column5: A square travels to one end, then comes back along the same path as if played in reverse, again and again.

column3: Stop-motion style (ストップモーション風)
column5: A star hops across in choppy steps at about 8 frames per second, each frame slightly off.

column3: Line boil (ラインボイル)
column5: A hand-drawn line picture wobbles every few frames while the picture itself stays still.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Typewriter (タイプライター)
column5: Text is typed into an input field one character at a time, then the send button lights up and is pressed.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Count-up (カウントアップ)
column5: A number races upward and locks onto its final value.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Kinetic typography (キネティックタイポグラフィ)
column5: Words move the way they mean: one stretches, one bounces, one spins, one slams down.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Text scramble (テキストスクランブル)
column5: Random characters keep changing, then lock into the right word from left to right.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Variable font animation (可変フォントアニメーション)
column5: The same word goes smoothly from thin to very bold and back, with a slider below showing the weight.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Text morph (テキストモーフ)
column5: The button label cycles through 保存, 已保存 and 再次保存; shared characters slide into place, new ones roll up from below and dropped ones drift away upward.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Karaoke bouncing ball (カラオケボール)
column5: A glowing yellow ball hops left to right over seven dim characters; each one it lands on turns white, glows and pops. At the end the line dims and starts over.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Tracking expand (トラッキング展開)
column5: On a cream ground the blurred, overlapping 展开视野 spreads out from the centre and sharpens while the rule below stretches with it, then blurs away again.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Strike and rewrite (取り消して書き直し)
column5: A slanted coral bar strikes through the white word 便宜 from the left and it dims; a curved arrow points down and a yellow brush-style 实惠 is written out character by character behind a pen dot.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Multilingual greeting (多言語あいさつ)
column5: Inside a pill-shaped frame 你好, Hello, こんにちは and Bonjour blur out upward and blur in from below, while the frame width and the dot after it glide to fit each word.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Split-flap board (反転フラップ表示板)
column5: Each cell on a dark board races through the alphabet, then settles in turn on time, destination, gate and status before flipping back to blank.

column3: Wave text (ウェーブテキスト)
column5: The letters of "WAVE TEXT" rise and fall one after another, like a wave.

column3: Text on a path (テキストオンパス)
column5: A line of text flows along a wavy line, each letter turning to follow it.

column3: Text mask (テキストマスク)
column5: Heavy letters are cut out so that a moving seascape shows only inside them; near the end of the cycle the whole picture appears.

column3: Water reflection (水面の反射)
column5: Under a night sky white text floats gently; below the line a coral upside-down copy sways, skews and breaks into horizontal ripples.

column3: Flag wave (フラッグウェーブ)
column5: Four characters hang from a pole on the left; each narrows, tilts and lifts slightly later than the last, so a wave runs to the right.

column3: Ink bleed (インクブリード)
column5: On rice-paper beige, four characters in turn tighten from soft ink blots into crisp shapes, hold, then spread and vanish.

column3: Liquid fill (リキッドフィル)
column5: Mint-outlined hollow text fills from the bottom with a wavy surface and rising bubbles, holds full, then drains quickly; a percentage shows below.

column3: Laser cut (レーザーカット)
column5: A sparking laser runs left to right along the middle of the word; once it passes, the top half slides up-left and the bottom half down-right with a slight tilt, then they rejoin.

column3: Text fan (文字の扇)
column5: Seven stacked copies of 扇 swing open around a yellow pivot below into a fan, with translucent coral copies either side of the white centre one, then fold shut.

column3: Neon flicker (ネオン点灯)
column5: On a dark brick wall the tubes of 营业中 flicker irregularly and light, washing the wall in coral; later only the last character drops out briefly, then the whole sign flickers once more.

column3: Echo stack (エコースタック)
column5: Five coral outline copies step out one by one to the upper right behind the bold white 回声, fainter further back, then slide back under it.

column3: Caution tape cross (立入禁止テープ)
column5: Over a dark background, 2 yellow tapes with black edges cross in an X, each carrying a repeated "禁止进入" that scrolls in the opposite direction to the other.

column3: Lightning strike (ライトニングストライク)
column5: The screen flashes white twice as a bolt cuts through, the word slams down from large, jolts, and stays with a yellow glow.

column3: Gravity flip (グラビティフリップ)
column5: Four characters accelerate up to the ceiling in turn, rotating 180° to hang upside down, bounce off it, then fall back to the floor completing 360° and bounce.

column3: Crumble (クランブル)
column5: Four characters tilt slightly in turn, then fall spinning and accelerating while shedding debris, vanish, and come back down from above into place.

column3: Rubber stamp (スタンプ)
column5: Two red framed stamps, “urgent” and “approved”, slam onto a document in turn from large and at an angle; the paper jolts and an imprint ring spreads.

column3: Slot machine (スロットマシン)
column5: Random characters stream vertically in four windows, slowing left to right to land on the result; when all stop the frame flashes twice.

column3: Swing letters (振り子の揺れ)
column5: Four characters hang on threads from a rail and swing lazily about yellow pivots above them, each slightly out of phase with its neighbour.

column3: Countdown slam (カウントダウン・スラム)
column5: 3, 2 and 1 slam down in turn from huge, each impact shaking the frame and sending out a ring; the final GO! is coral with burst lines.

column3: Text cylinder (テキストシリンダー)
column5: Three cylinders, each wrapped in ten copies of one character, spin about a horizontal axis in alternating directions; near copies are larger and brighter, far ones hidden.

column3: Text tunnel (文字トンネル)
column5: Layers of 穿越 keep growing out of a tiny point in the centre and rush off the edges, alternating white and coral, with a dark glow at the centre.

column3: Extruded text (押し出し文字)
column5: 立体 with a white face and darker coral layers stacked behind for depth turns slowly once around the vertical axis, showing its thickness side-on.

column3: Sphere of words (文字の球)
column5: Characters scattered over a sphere slowly spin; those in front turn bold and dark while those behind fade to pale shadows.

column3: Type ocean (文字の海)
column5: A perspective field of letters swells on 2 overlapping waves; letters on the crests turn white and bold while those in the troughs sink into deep blue.

column3: Text corridor (文字の回廊)
column5: In a one-point corridor the floor, ceiling and both walls are filled with 文字走廊 in different colours that keep flowing toward the viewer, with the vanishing point sunk in shadow.

column3: Line draw (ラインドロー)
column5: A chart line draws itself on, and is later erased from its starting end.

column3: Shape morph (モーフィング)
column5: A shape changes smoothly from circle to square to star to heart, with its colour.

column3: Repeater (リピーター)
column5: One shape is duplicated around a circle, and the copies turn and pulse slightly out of step.

column3: Kaleidoscope (カレイドスコープ)
column5: An 8-way symmetrical pattern turns and spreads out from the centre, like a kaleidoscope.

column3: Wave interference (波の干渉)
column5: A cyan wave A and an orange wave B flow in opposite directions while the combined wave below swells and flattens, and 3 dots on a vertical dashed line track the values.

column3: Signature animation (サイン描画)
column5: A one-stroke cursive signature is written left to right behind a coral pen-tip dot, then a gently curved underline sweeps in beneath it.

column3: ECG heartbeat line (心電図ライン)
column5: On a dark green grid a glowing ECG trace sweeps left to right, older trace dims, and a heart on the right swells with each beat.

column3: Growing tree (ツリーグロース)
column5: A ground line spreads, the trunk grows up, 4 branches and 5 twigs sprout in turn, leaves pop open in random order, and a caption rises below.

column3: Logo build reveal (ロゴビルド)
column5: A white ring draws itself, then a coral square turned 45° is outlined and filled, a white centre dot pops in, and 星火工作室 with an English subtitle slides in from the left.

column3: Exploded view (分解図)
column5: A phone separates into its layers to show how it is built, then assembles again.

column3: Coin flip (コインフリップ)
column5: Four gold coins carrying characters hop up in turn, spin twice, land and bounce once; the back shows a star.

column3: Gear train (ギアトレイン)
column5: A large blue gear turns clockwise while coral and yellow pinions meshed with it spin faster the other way, teeth staying in each other's gaps; a status line sits beside them.

column3: Infinite helix carousel (無限らせんカルーセル)
column5: Against a navy background, a row of small photo cards follows a horizontal helix, turning around its axis while moving right. Cards that swing to the front grow larger and brighter, with a shadow and a sweeping highlight; cards that swing to the back show a navy reverse and turn dim and hazy. The motion pushes and glides: it almost stops at the loop seam, speeds through the middle, and cards at both ends melt into the vignette.

column3: Cube flip wave (キューブの反転波)
column5: On a dark ground, a slab of cubes rolls over in a diagonal wave, their tops cycling through 4 colours like a flipping display.

column3: Domino run (ドミノ倒し)
column5: Black and red dominoes along an S-curve topple in an accelerating chain, then stand back up in reverse as the clip rewinds.

column3: Impossible triangle (不可能な三角形)
column5: Coloured blocks drop one by one onto a pastel ground to build 3 edges whose ends meet into an impossible triangle that slowly turns.

column3: Möbius strip (メビウスの帯)
column5: A Möbius strip sways gently in a dark space while orange-pink and white stripes flow along it, front quietly becoming back.

column3: Infinity room (インフィニティ・ルーム)
column5: The camera glides forward through lights in 4 hues hanging in darkness, mirrored in the floor, their brightness breathing in waves into the depth.

column3: Spinning vinyl (回るレコード)
column5: On red, the record label spins at a steady speed while the groove highlights stay fixed toward the light and the silver tonearm rests still.

column3: Card flourish (カードの扇開き)
column5: Cards fly from a deck on green felt into a fan, flip face up one by one, turn back over, then gather into the deck again.

column3: Receipt printing (レシート印字)
column5: A dark paper slot fades in and a white receipt eases out from the top, revealing the shop name, 3 item lines and "Total · Shipped" under a dashed rule, before everything fades.

column3: Dots settling into a normal distribution (点が正規分布にまとまる)
column5: Dots pop up like a cloud inside a purple plot, fly off with slight staggers to stack into bell-shaped columns, the counter climbs to 098 and the mean line turns solid.

column3: Network diffusion (ネットワーク拡散)
column5: The source on the left glows and ripples, the signal passes rightward one hop at a time, each traversed edge glows coral, reached nodes pop alight, and the hop and reach counters climb.

column3: Map route animation (ルートアニメーション)
column5: On a faint map with grid lines, three pins drop and bounce in turn; a blue line draws along the dashed planned route, a glowing dot travels with it, and the end pin pops.

column3: Fingerprint scan (指紋スキャン)
column5: In a rounded sensor box fingerprint arcs draw from the inside out, a green light bar sweeps down and back, the ridges dim, a check mark draws and the frame glows green.

column3: Audio waveform (オーディオ波形)
column5: On a player panel 44 thin rounded bars stretch and shrink unevenly about the centre line, the played part in coral, while a ripple spreads around the play button on the left.

column3: Dot-matrix sign (LED ドットマトリクス)
column5: On an angled LED board, amber dot letters scroll right to left, with lit dots glowing softly.

column3: Sci-fi HUD (SF の計器)
column5: Cyan concentric rings turn in opposite directions on deep navy while a scan sector sweeps and the central readout and side data keep changing.

column3: Radar sweep (レーダースキャン)
column5: A trailing sweep circles a dark green scope; coastline dots and targets brighten as it passes, then dim gradually.

column3: Flight paths (世界の航路)
column5: On an angled dot map, orange arcs spring from hubs one after another, and lights travel along each finished arc to the far end.

column3: Market candles (ローソク足チャート)
column5: Candles grow one by one from the left on a dark chart, red for up and green for down, with moving averages curving along and volume bars below.

column3: Neural net (ニューラルネット)
column5: Over deep navy, orange signal lights run rightward along the strongest weights of a layered graph while nodes brighten and dim with activation.

column3: Electron orbital (電子雲)
column5: A cloud of blue and orange dots in the shape of a 3d orbital turns slowly on a dark background, with a white core glow and an elliptical orbit line.

column3: Sankey flow (サンキー図)
column5: Bands grow rightward from 4 energy sources on the left, shifting colour as they split into 4 uses on the right.

column3: Barcode scan (バーコードスキャン)
column5: A white packing slip settles onto a grey desk, a cyan laser sweeps the barcode left to right and switches off, and a green "Verified · ready to ship" rises in.

column3: Oscilloscope trace (オシロスコープの波形)
column5: A dark scope panel fades in and a vertical light beam travels left to right, tracing a cyan waveform that swings 3 times with shrinking height, then the beam fades out.

column3: Matrix rain (マトリックス・レイン)
column5: On black, columns of katakana, digits and letters keep falling; the head of each column glows white and the trail darkens to green behind it, the glyphs changing as they go.

column3: Burst (バースト)
column5: A like heart fills in, and a ring, lines and dots burst outward at the same moment.

column3: Particles (パーティクル)
column5: Particles keep shooting up from an emitter, spread out and fall.

column3: Light sweep (ライトスイープ)
column5: A band of light crosses the surface of a logo badge at an angle.

column3: Glitch (グリッチ)
column5: Text slices shift sideways, colours split and small bars appear, with no brightness flashing.

column3: Impact shake (インパクトシェイク)
column5: A heavy headline slab drops with a thud and the whole frame shakes from the impact.

column3: Confetti burst (紙吹雪)
column5: On a dark purple background the word "恭喜" dips and springs back while confetti in 5 colors fans up from below, spinning and falling in arcs before fading; it repeats every 3.2 s.

column3: Falling petals (花びらの舞い落ち)
column5: Pink petals sway, spin and flip as they fall over a dark plum background; a cursor sweeps once from left to right, pushing petals along its path aside before they settle back into their fall.

column3: Fireworks (花火)
column5: On a starry night sky a cursor clicks 3 spots in turn; each click sends out a ripple and a rocket rises from the bottom to burst into gold, blue or pink sparks that droop and fade.

column3: Mask transition (マスクトランジション)
column5: A circle- or star-shaped window grows, showing the next scene inside it.

column3: Shape transition (シェイプトランジション)
column5: Coloured bands sweep across and cover the frame; when they leave, the next scene is there.

column3: Liquid transition (リキッドトランジション)
column5: Paint-like liquid drips down from the top and fills the frame, becoming the next scene.

column3: Zoom through (ズームスルー)
column5: The camera pushes into the hole of a letter O and comes out in the next scene.

column3: Flip (フリップ)
column5: A card turns over around its vertical axis and shows its other side.

column3: Push transition (プッシュ)
column5: The next scene slides in from the side and pushes the current one out with it.

column3: Blinds transition (ブラインド)
column5: Gaps in a row of thin strips widen until the next scene is fully open.

column3: Cube transition (キューブ)
column5: Like a turning cube, the front face swings away and the next face comes round.

column3: Page curl (ページめくり)
column5: A page peels back from its corner and folds over, revealing the next page beneath.

column3: Pixelate (ピクセレート)
column5: The picture turns into coarser and coarser blocks, switches at the coarsest point, then sharpens again.

column3: Shatter (ガラス割れ)
column5: The picture cracks like glass, the shards fly off and the next scene is revealed.

column3: Split screen (スプリットスクリーン)
column5: One full-frame scene splits into two panels, then three, each with its own scene moving.

column3: Burn transition (バーントランジション)
column5: A small hole burns open near the middle of the city night view, and its wavy, irregular edge spreads outward slowly at first, then faster. A dark brown scorched band runs outside the edge with a glowing orange fire line just inside it, and a few sparks drift up and out from the edge before dying. The mountain view shows through the hole, and the switch is done once the whole frame has burned open. The second half burns back to the city the same way.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Danmaku comments (弾幕コメント)
column5: A person's silhouette stands in front of seaside footage while short comments in 5 rows above slide from right to left at steady speeds. Rows move at different speeds, so comments in the fast row overtake the slow ones. Most are white with a dark outline, a few are yellow, mint or coral, and my own comment has a white frame. Around the person's head and shoulders the comments are softly cut away, so the person always sits in front of them. A player bar with a 弹 button runs along the bottom.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Quote card (名言カード)
column5: In the middle of a navy screen a rounded paper-coloured card pops in with a slight overshoot. A big coral quote mark drops in at the top left and bounces to a stop, then the 2 lines 好的设计， and 是把不必要的都拿掉。 rise in one after the other. A yellow marker then sweeps left to right across the 4 characters 不必要的, set a little apart from their neighbours so they stand out. The source fades in at the bottom right; after a pause the card shrinks slightly and fades, leaving the empty screen.

column3: Zoom callout (ズームコールアウト)
column5: Over the city night view a small yellow circle drifts through the buildings along a figure-8. A dashed line runs from it to a big white circle at the top right, which shows the same scene at 3× around the small circle's position; the flicker of the window lights changes inside it at the same moment. A label under the big circle shows the zoom and the small circle's coordinates, which change as it moves. The original frame itself never zooms or moves.

column3: Snowfall (降雪)
column5: On a night street with a navy sky, building silhouettes and a snowy road, snow falls without a break. Far flakes are small and crisp and fall slowly, middle flakes are a bit bigger and faster, and near flakes are large, faint out-of-focus bokeh that cross quickly. Every flake sways gently side to side as it falls. Flakes passing through the street lamp's cone of light turn warm white and look a little bigger, and the light pools on the ground.

column3: Duration (デュレーション)
column5: Three squares cover the same distance in 0.2 s, 0.4 s and 0.8 s; a bar under each shows how long it takes.

column3: Delay (ディレイ)
column5: Four bars wait 0, 0.15, 0.3 and 0.45 s before they start; the squares on the right slide in in the same order.

column3: Spring animation (スプリングアニメーション)
column5: Three dots with the same stiffness but different damping ratios move to the end line; small graphs on the right plot position over time.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Blur text reveal (ぼかし表示テキスト)
column5: On a dark background, a large white-and-blue headline sharpens in word by word, then the subline below appears letter by letter. At the end everything blurs and fades away again.

column3: Fuzzy text (ざらつき揺れ文字)
column5: Large black type on a light background has finely ragged edges; when the cursor hovers, the strips shift far apart and shake hard. When it leaves, the type settles back to the fine fuzz.

column3: Fold text (折り紙展開テキスト)
column5: On a deep blue background, a yellow header strip appears, then white paper strips unfold beneath it 1 by 1 until the text can be read. At the end they fold back up from the bottom and disappear.

column2: Text animation / Letter by letter & layout
column3: Scroll velocity type (スクロール速度で流れる文字)
column5: On a dark background, 2 rows of big words flow in opposite directions; a fast scroll down makes the words rush and lean like italics, and scrolling up reverses them. When scrolling stops, the letterforms straighten up again.

column3: Tipping balance scale (傾く天秤)
column5: A beam on a central post with pans A and B. 5 gold coins fall into pan B one after another and stack up; the beam tips further with each coin, sways with damping, and finally levels out again.

column3: Newton's cradle (ニュートンのゆりかご)
column5: 5 balls hang on strings from a bar. The gold ball on the left and the grey ball on the right swing out in turn, making 5 full swings in 5.4 s before coming to rest. The caption reads 「一个动作，连锁反应」.

column3: Growing coin stacks (積み上がるコイン)
column5: 5 stacks of gold coins on a ground line. The left stack starts first and each new coin drops a little onto the top; by 3.6 s the stacks hold 4, 7, 10, 13 and 16 coins.

column3: Compound growth curve (複利カーブ)
column5: On left and bottom axes, the growth curve for 10% per period over 40 periods is drawn from the origin. A white dot rides the tip to the right, the curve shoots up near the end, and 「×45」 appears at the top right.

column3: Sliding year timeline (年号タイムライン)
column5: Years 10 apart sit along a line and slide left starting from 1930. The year at the centre turns large and gold, the others shrink and fade with distance, and it comes to rest on 2020.

column3: Growing knowledge tree (知識ツリー)
column5: From the gold 「主题」 at the bottom, 3 branches grow up to 「概念」, 「方法」 and 「案例」, then 6 gold dots appear above them. Nodes pop in with a spring and the whole tree drifts gently up and down.

column3: Decision tree path (決定木)
column5: From 「要不要继续？」 at the top, 「继续」 and 「止损」 and then 「越陷越深」「侥幸回本」「损失封顶」「重新出发」 pop in layer by layer. Then the path 「止损」 → 「重新出发」 turns gold, the rest dims, and a gold ring circles the end.

column3: Radial mind map (放射状マインドマップ)
column5: A glowing gold circle 「想法」 sits in the centre. 6 branches spring out one by one clockwise from the top, each with a label beside its end dot. 3 faint concentric ellipses sit behind, and the whole map turns slowly.

column3: Stacking word cards (積み重なる言葉)
column5: 4 cards in red, orange, blue and grey read 「计划」「执行」「复盘」「迭代」. Each one shrinks down from a larger size onto the card before, tilted slightly left or right, and the cards below dip and spring back every time.

column3: Pan (パン)
column5: The camera stays in place and pivots from left to right; because it is a rotation, near and far layers slide sideways by the same amount.

column3: Tilt (ティルト)
column5: The camera stays in place and pivots upward, from a person at ground level up to the top of a tower.

column3: Dolly in (ドリーイン)
column4: dolly,dolly in,push in,track in,move forward,parallax,camera move
column5: The camera itself moves toward the subject; near objects grow and pass quickly while the distant mountains barely change.

column3: Zoom in (ズームイン)
column5: The camera does not move; only the focal length gets longer, so the whole picture enlarges by the same ratio.

column3: Tracking shot (トラッキング)
column5: The camera moves sideways at the same speed as a walking person; the person stays centred while nearer posts sweep past faster.

column3: Orbit (Arc shot) (オービット)
column5: The camera travels on a circle around the subject; the person stays centred while the trees and buildings behind sweep sideways.

column3: Crane up (クレーンアップ)
column5: The camera rises while tilting down until it looks down on the person.

column3: Dolly zoom (Vertigo) (ドリーズーム)
column5: The camera pulls back while zooming in by the same ratio; the person keeps the same size and only the background closes in.

column3: Rack focus (ラックフォーカス)
column4: rack focus,focus pull,pull focus,depth of field,blur,bokeh,foreground
column5: The camera does not move; focus shifts from a flower in the foreground to a person behind it, swapping which one is blurred.

column3: Handheld (手持ち)
column5: Adds a small, irregular shake to the whole frame, as if the camera were held by hand instead of on a tripod.

column3: FPV drone shot (FPV)
column5: A first-person view flying low and fast between two rows of trees, banking from side to side.

column3: Dutch angle (ダッチアングル)
column5: A level camera rolls around its lens axis and holds with the horizon on a diagonal.

column3: Slow motion (スローモーション)
column5: In front of a fixed camera a person rises and falls slowly through a jump while leaves drift down slowly; the whole action is stretched out.

column3: Speed ramp (スピードランプ)
column4: speed ramp,time remap,ramping,fast to slow,variable speed,velocity
column5: Within one shot the playback speed changes smoothly from fast to slow; a graph at bottom left shows the speed.

column3: Time-lapse (タイムラプス)
column5: With a fixed camera, 06:00 to 18:00 is compressed into a few seconds; sun, clouds, people and shadows move in fast forward.

column3: Freeze frame (フリーズフレーム)
column5: The picture stops at the moment a jumping person reaches the top, then resumes from the same frame 1.4 s later.

column3: Jump cut (ジャンプカット)
column5: Camera position and framing stay the same while the person's position and the clock jump; time is skipped inside one scene.

column3: Match cut (マッチカット)
column5: A thrown ball becomes, in the next shot, a sun at the same position and size; two different scenes are joined on a matching shape.

column3: Whip pan (ホイップパン)
column5: The camera swings sideways very fast and the next scene is swapped in during the streaked blur.

column3: Cross dissolve (クロスディゾルブ)
column5: The next picture is laid over the current one and its opacity rises until it takes over; both show through each other midway.

column3: Wipe (ワイプ)
column5: A vertical edge moves from left to right and the next picture replaces the current one behind it.

column3: Smash cut (スマッシュカット)
column5: A quiet scene of a person asleep cuts with no warning straight to an intense one; the volume meter jumps at the same moment.

column3: J-cut (Jカット)
column4: j-cut,j cut,split edit,audio lead,sound first,audio transition,edit
column5: The next scene's audio starts before the picture changes; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.

column3: L-cut (Lカット)
column4: l-cut,l cut,split edit,audio lag,sound carries over,audio transition,edit
column5: The previous scene's audio carries on for a while after the picture has changed; the picture is shown on top with video and audio timelines below.

column3: Establishing shot (エスタブリッシングショット)
column5: A high wide shot first shows two people standing left and right in the space; at 2.4 s it cuts straight to a close shot of the one on the left, who starts speaking. The audience already knows the other person is to his right.

column3: Shot/reverse shot (切り返し)
column4: shot reverse shot,shot/reverse shot,ots,over the shoulder,dialogue,cut,editing
column5: Over B's shoulder we see A speak, then a cut over A's shoulder to B answering, then back to A; the listener shows only shoulders and back. A stays on the left of the frame and B on the right throughout.

column3: Match on action (アクションつなぎ)
column4: match on action,cutting on action,match cut,action continuity,cut,editing,continuity
column5: A person walks across at a steady pace; halfway, the picture cuts from a front camera to a three-quarter camera. Position and stride carry straight through the cut, and a blue dashed mark flashes under the feet to show it is the same movement.
