column3: 180-degree rule (イマジナリーライン（180度ルール）)
column4: 180-degree rule,180 degree rule,axis of action,imaginary line,crossing the line,screen direction,continuity
column5: A small top-down map at bottom right shows the line between the two people, the camera side in pale blue and the far side hatched as off limits; both shots stay on one side, so A is always on the left.

column3: Extreme long shot (超ロングショット)
column4: extreme long shot,els,extreme wide shot,ews,shot size,framing,landscape
column5: From a distant, slightly high camera, mountains, buildings, trees and clouds fill the frame while a person only about 20 px tall walks across and back.

column3: Full shot (フルショット)
column4: full shot,fs,wide shot,ws,head to toe,shot size,framing
column5: The person fits the frame from head to toe, takes one big step with the arms swinging, holds and then draws back.

column3: Medium long shot (ニーショット)
column4: medium long shot,mls,medium full shot,cowboy shot,knee shot,shot size,framing
column5: The bottom edge falls at the knees; the person lifts a leg, steps out and draws back, so the arc of the thigh rising and falling is clear against a softly blurred background.

column3: Medium shot (ウエストショット)
column5: The bottom edge falls at the waist; the person raises one arm beside the head, waves it back and forth and lowers it again.

column3: Medium close-up (バストショット)
column4: medium close-up,mcu,bust shot,chest up,talking head,shot size,dialogue
column5: The person, chest up and slightly left of centre, says two lines: the mouth moves and a subtitle appears with each line, there is a blink in the pause between them, and a "！" pops up above the head at the end.

column3: Close-up (クローズアップ)
column5: Head and shoulders fill the frame: the eyes shift to one side, there is a blink, the body leans back a little, and finally the gaze returns to the front.

column3: Extreme close-up (大クローズアップ)
column5: The frame holds only a band across the eyes: the gaze sweeps left and right once, with one quick blink along the way.

column3: Macro shot (マクロ撮影)
column4: macro shot,macro,macro photography,focus pull,detail,shallow depth of field,shot size
column5: A tiny fly agaric half buried in moss fills the height of the frame: a round dome cap covered in rows of small white warts, white membrane scraps on the rim, a slender white stem with a skirt ring just under the cap, and a bulbous base wrapped in scale rings. Focus starts far behind with everything soft, then pulls onto the mushroom. Big foreground grass blades, the grass behind and the coloured bokeh blobs of the background stay blurred by how far they are from the focus plane. On the cap an ant walks from right to left, turns and walks back. The camera pushes in very slowly, and the "1 cm" scale bar at the bottom left grows with it. In a small side-view diagram at the bottom right, a thin blue band marking the sharp zone moves with the focus. At the end focus returns to the distance and the push-in eases back.

column3: Rule of thirds (三分割法)
column5: The person moves from the centre to the left third line and the horizon drops from the middle to the lower third, while two horizontal and two vertical third lines and their four crossings appear.

column3: Centered composition (日の丸構図)
column5: The person moves from the left onto the centre line; the centre line and a ring marking the visual weight at head and chest appear. The background has a building on the left and trees on the right, so it is not symmetrical.

column3: Symmetrical composition (シンメトリー構図)
column5: A line of stepping stones runs up the middle the whole time; pairs of trees grow on both sides from near to far, mirroring each other across the centre line.

column3: Leading lines (リーディングライン)
column5: The two edges of a road converge from the bottom of the frame to a point in the distance; the person moves from off the road onto that point, and dashed lines flow along the edges towards him.

column3: Negative space (余白（ネガティブスペース）)
column5: The person moves to the left while the buildings and tree on the right fade away; the large plain area left behind is outlined and labelled as negative space.

column3: Frame within a frame (フレームインフレーム)
column5: A dark doorway fades in close to the camera and frames the distant person a second time; a light strip along its inner edge shows that it has thickness.

column3: Foreground, middle ground & background (前景・中景・背景)
column5: The lake and woods behind, the person in the middle and the flowers in front slide sideways by different amounts, creating parallax; each layer is labelled.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Backlighting (逆光)
column5: The sun moves from outside the frame to directly behind the person's head; a thin bright edge appears around the figure, a pale warm haze covers the frame and the side facing the camera darkens.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Rim light (リムライト)
column5: The surroundings go dark and two lights behind the person, left and right, draw thin bright edges only along both sides of the head and shoulders; the plan at the bottom right shows where the two lights are.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Silhouette (シルエット)
column5: As the exposure is set for the bright evening sky, the person, buildings, lamp and tree turn into flat black shapes with no detail and only the sky stays bright.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Split lighting (スプリットライティング)
column5: The light swings from near the front (20°) to directly at the side (90°); the shadow on the head grows from a crescent to exactly half, splitting the face down the middle.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Rembrandt lighting (レンブラントライティング)
column5: A light 45° to the side and 45° up comes on; the right side of the face falls into shadow except for a small inverted triangle of light on the shadow-side cheek.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Butterfly lighting (バタフライライティング)
column4: butterfly lighting,paramount lighting,beauty lighting,portrait lighting,overhead light,glamour
column5: A light in front of the face and high above comes on; the face lights evenly on both sides and only a small symmetrical shadow falls under the chin.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Golden hour (ゴールデンアワー)
column4: golden hour,magic hour,sunset light,warm light,long shadows,low sun
column5: The sun drops to just above the horizon; sky and ground turn orange, the left side of the person lights up and the shadows of the lamp and tree stretch far to the right.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Blue hour (ブルーアワー)
column5: Once the sun has set, the sky turns two bands of deep blue, the windows and street lamp come on in amber and the person becomes a dark blue shape.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: God rays (ゴッドレイ)
column5: The surroundings darken and nine beams fan in from a source beyond the upper left, crossing the person; each beam flickers in brightness and dark gaps stay between them.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Window shadow pattern (窓枠の影)
column4: window light pattern,window shadow,hard light,afternoon,grid shadow,lighting
column5: Light in the shape of 3×3 panes falls slantwise on the person and the light wall, with shadow everywhere else; as the clock runs from 15:00 to 15:40 the grid slides right and leans further.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Follow spotlight (スポットライト)
column5: The stage lights drop and a round pool of light follows the person walking left and right; outside it is almost black, a beam comes down from above, and the audience heads are silhouetted in front.

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Dragging the shutter (スローシンクロ)
column4: dragging the shutter,slow sync flash,light trails,party,flash,lighting
column5: A garland of coloured bulbs hangs over the night street; a flash goes off white for an instant and the person comes out bright and sharp, while bulbs, windows and lamps draw curved coloured trails; the top-right readout changes from 1/60s to "1/4s · ⚡".

column2: Light & color / Lighting & time of day
column3: Under lighting (アンダーライト)
column5: The room darkens and a torch in front of the chest lights the person from below; the head is bright at the bottom and darker towards the top, and a large shadow stretches up the wall behind.

column3: Dappled light (木漏れ日)
column5: The scene sinks into greenish shade and uneven patches of sun scatter over the person, buildings and ground; the wind moves them together, neighbouring patches merging and parting; oval spots line the ground and blurred leaves hang into the top corners.

column3: Caustics (コースティクス)
column5: The whole cycle is underwater in a pool. At the top a wavy band of surface is seen from below, and 5 slanted beams of light come in. The back wall is tiled, and the floor has perspective tiles and a lane line. A swimmer in a red suit, cap and goggles waves, and bubbles rise. A net of bright curved lines spreads over the wall, the floor and the skin, brightest where the lines meet; on the floor the net looks squashed. The net slowly changes shape and drifts, but the tile lines and the figure never distort. At the start and end the surface is calm and the net gentle; the waves pick up from 0.2 s and calm down again at the end.

column3: Campfire light (焚き火の光)
column5: Deep blue night; the orange light of a fire at the lower right lights the side of the person facing it, flickering with the flames; the light falls off fast and sparks drift upwards.

column3: Screen glow (画面の光)
column5: The room goes dark and only the laptop in front of the person glows; cool white light from slightly below reaches the face and chest and falls off fast, jumping in brightness whenever the screen changes.

column3: Foggy light (霧の中の光)
column5: Fog rolls into the evening street; of the four layers — far hills, buildings, trees with street lamps, and the person in front — the further ones turn closer to the fog colour and lose contrast; a fog band drifts along the horizon and each lamp gets a large halo and a cone of light below.

column3: Moonlight (月夜)
column5: The sky turns a deep near-black blue and a full moon rises at the upper left; the person is lit on one side by cold blue light from above, with clear shadows; a silver glint shimmers on the ground and the windows stay dark.

column3: Bicolor lighting (バイカラー)
column5: The surroundings darken as a magenta light comes on at the left and a cyan one at the right; each side of the person takes one colour, blending to pale violet down the middle, and both colours spill onto the wall.

column3: Color temperature (色温度)
column5: A kelvin scale sits at the lower right; its pointer moves 5500 K → 2000 K → 10000 K → 5500 K, and the picture turns orange at low values and blue at high ones.

column3: Bokeh (ボケ)
column4: bokeh,shallow depth of field,background blur,wide aperture,f/1.4,out of focus,lights
column5: As the aperture opens, the in-focus person stays sharp, the buildings behind soften and the street lamps and distant lights spread into large, pale discs.

column3: Tilt-shift (ティルトシフト)
column4: tilt-shift,miniature,miniature effect,fake miniature,selective focus,toy town,focus band
column5: The top and bottom bands of the street blur while only the middle band with the road, the car and the small people stays in focus, so the street looks like a model.

column3: Long exposure (長時間露光)
column4: long exposure,light trails,slow shutter,night photography,car trails,motion
column5: The street turns to night; the moving car fades to almost nothing, a red tail-light line stretches out behind it and white and amber lines run along the opposite lane.

column3: Panning shot (流し撮り)
column5: The camera follows the moving car: the car stays sharp in the middle of the frame while only the buildings, trees and lamps behind it streak sideways.

column3: Lens flare (レンズフレア)
column5: As the sun comes out from behind a building, rays appear around it and a line of light dots, hexagons and a ring runs from the sun through the centre of the frame to the opposite side.

column3: Fisheye lens (魚眼レンズ)
column5: The middle of the street scene bulges out; the vertical lines of the buildings and the lines of the road bow outward while the corners stay where they are.

column3: Chromatic aberration (色収差)
column5: The street scene is split into red, green and blue and the three are laid back together at slightly different sizes, so red and cyan fringes appear on the edges of the person, buildings and lamps, larger towards the sides.

column3: Vignette (周辺減光（ビネット）)
column5: The frame darkens smoothly from the corners while the person and the road in the middle stay bright.

column3: Bloom (ブルーム)
column5: A car crosses a night street corner; glows spread only around the windows, street lamps and car lights, while the dark sky and buildings stay unchanged.

column3: Soft focus (ソフトフォーカス)
column5: A blurred, brightened copy of the whole scene is layered on; the sun and the lit edge of the person spread, the shadows lift slightly, and the outlines of hills, tree and person remain clear.

column3: Prism effect (プリズム)
column5: On the night street only the windows and bulbs split into six colours from red to violet, offset towards the upper left; a faint rainbow band slants across.

column3: High-key (ハイキー)
column5: The landscape and the person turn to light, near-white colours with very faint shadows, and the hump of the histogram at the bottom right moves to the right end.

column3: Low-key (ローキー)
column5: Most of the frame sinks into darkness and the sun goes out; only the right edge of the bust, lit from the side, stays bright. The histogram hump moves to the left end.

column3: Black and white (モノクロ)
column5: The colour drains from the same landscape; the sun and the light on the figure turn grey and the shapes read only by their brightness.

column3: Duotone (デュオトーン)
column5: The colours of the same landscape are replaced by a range between just two colours: indigo in the darks and pink in the lights.

column3: Teal and orange (ティール＆オレンジ)
column4: teal and orange,orange and teal,cinematic,color grading,blockbuster,film look
column5: In the same landscape the sky, hills, ground and the shadowed figure shift to teal while the sunlit edge of the figure and the sun shift to orange, a complementary contrast.

column3: Film grain (フィルムグレイン)
column5: Fine grain appears over the whole of the same landscape and the colours lean slightly towards a warm cream.

column3: Light leak (ライトリーク)
column5: From the right edge of the same landscape a band of leaked light comes in, pale yellow on the inside and red at the edge, swaying slowly.

column3: Double exposure (二重露光（多重露光）)
column5: The background turns white and the landscape of hills, house, trees and sun appears, scaled down, only inside the shape of the bust.

column3: Flat lay (フラットレイ)
column5: We look straight down at a linen cloth on a wooden table. A soy-milk bowl, a plate of buns, a plate of fried dough sticks, a teacup and chopsticks drop in one after another; while falling each is slightly larger with a far, soft shadow, and once it lands the shadow shrinks to a short, faint ring. The dishes stay perfect circles throughout and the chopsticks run parallel to the cloth's lower edge. Then guide lines and the labels "circle", "parallel" and "space" appear, and finally everything is cleared in reverse order back to the empty cloth.

column3: Before and after (ビフォーアフター)
column5: Three storyboard panels light up in turn. Panel 1 is a messy room: clutter on the floor, a crooked picture, clothes on the sofa. In panel 2 a large, blurred hand right in front of the lens sweeps left to right, and the room is tidy the moment the hand covers the frame. Panel 3 is the tidy room in the same framing. Then blue dashed boxes appear over the sofa and picture in panels 1 and 3, joined by a line labelled "same camera".

column3: Beat-synced montage (ビート合わせのカット編集)
column4: beat sync,montage,music edit,cut on beat,short video,rhythm
column5: A beat bar along the bottom has a beat line every 0.5 s, with a taller blue accent line every 2 beats. The picture changes only on the beats: on an accent it cuts to a close-up of the face that pops slightly larger and settles back; on the weak beats it alternates between wide and medium shots. Colour blocks above the bar record which shot each segment used, turning solid as the playhead passes.

column3: First and last frame (最初と最後のフレーム)
column5: Three panels sit side by side. The first frame on the left and the last frame on the right never move, each with a lock icon and a "first frame · locked" / "last frame · locked" label. Only the middle "process only" panel plays: the figure walks from left to right, stops and raises an arm, ending in exactly the last frame's pose. A timeline below is pinned to the first and last frames, and the blue progress and playhead travel only between them.

column3: Action beats (動作を拍に分ける)
column5: Five equal panels light up in turn. A figure seated at a table, seen side-on, holds still, slowly reaches out and grips the cup, pauses for a beat, quickly lifts the cup to the mouth (head tipping back slightly, cup tilting towards the lips) and ends in the drinking pose. The time bar below is split by each beat's real length: the slow part is long and light blue, the pause is its own grey segment, the fast part is short and dark blue, with a black playhead moving along.

column3: One shot, one action (1カット1動作)
column4: one action per shot,shot breakdown,prompt clarity,storyboard,camera move,pacing
column5: First the bad example: in one wide panel the figure walks and waves while the camera pushes in. Red tags "walk", "wave" and "push-in" appear one by one, then a red frame and the red caption "✕ one shot crammed with 3 actions". It then switches to 3 panels played in turn: walk · locked off, wave · locked off, stand still · push-in, with the blue caption "✓ split into 3 shots, 1 action each" underneath.

column3: Three-second hook (冒頭3秒のフック)
column5: Three panels light up in turn. Panel 1 is the result in close-up: a two-tier cake with strawberries, its candle flame flickering, background blurred, the camera creeping in. Panel 2 is a close shot of the face: the mouth opens, a "Wow!" bubble pops up and the eyes blink once. Panel 3 is the wide establishing shot: the person stands by the table and raises an arm. On the timeline below, the first 3 s are filled blue and labelled "first 3 s · hook", and panel 1 ends exactly as the playhead leaves that stretch.

column3: Product three-beat (商品の3段構成)
column4: product video,three beats,hero shot,detail close-up,lifestyle shot,storyboard
column5: The same blue thermos is the focus of all 3 panels. Panel 1, "whole · orbit", stands it on a turntable for one slow full turn, its highlight and logo sliding from side to side. Panel 2, "selling point · side-lit close-up", is a big close-up on black: a light sweeps left to right and the cap's grip ridges light up one by one, then a "non-slip ridges" label appears. Panel 3, "in use", is outdoors: a hand holds the bottle and sways it once, keeping it in the centre of the frame.

column3: Shot list script (絵コンテ台本)
column5: A table on the left has the headers "# / duration / size & move / picture / sound", and each row is written out left to right as its shot begins, the current row turning blue: wide · locked off "street corner at dawn, she walks in" with ambience; medium · push-in "stops at the café door" with footsteps; close-up · locked off "looks up at the sign" with a wind chime; medium close-up · locked off "pushes the door, smiles and says morning" with "Morning!"; long shot · pull-back "warm light inside, she sits down" as music comes in. A small preview on the right plays that row's shot, with a progress bar and "shot N · size" below.

column3: Unboxing sequence (開封動画)
column5: Five panels light up in turn. Panel 1 is the box from straight above with a blue ribbon cross, growing very slowly. Panel 2: two hands lift the lid open. Panel 3: the bottle rises out of the box and stops, with a soft halo of light behind it for the reveal. Panel 4: on black, the cap ridges slide past from right to left. Panel 5 pulls back to a medium shot of the person turning the bottle in front of their chest. A line chart under the panels plots how close each shot is, getting closer and closer before pulling back at the end, with played points turning blue.

column3: B-roll over talking head (トークの間に挟む映像)
column5: On the left is the finished picture: with no insert it shows the speaker in a medium close-up, mouth moving. In 3 places the picture switches to B-roll: a close-up of the bottle in hand, a slowly rotating overhead shot of a desk with a notebook, pen and bottle, and a city view with drifting clouds. The subtitles keep running in a black strip at the bottom, with the keyword highlighted in yellow. On the right are 2 tracks: the B-roll track with 3 blocks, and the dark "voice-over" track whose waveform never stops, labelled "sound never breaks"; a red playhead crosses both.

column3: 15-second ad script (15秒CM台本)
column5: The 4 panels are as wide as their 3 : 7 : 3 : 2 seconds, so the selling-point part is clearly longest and the ending shortest. "Hook": the bottle drops from above and bounces, with the red caption "Drop-proof?". "Selling points × 2": first the grip ridges glow under side light on black, then steam rises and a counter climbs to 12h with "keeps hot". "Use": a hand carries it outdoors. "Product + slogan": the bottle centred on a plain pale-blue background with the slogan in a blue bar beneath. Seconds 3s, 7s, 3s and 2s sit under the panels, and the corner shows elapsed time such as "07 / 15s".

column3: WeChat article header (公众号のヘッダー画像)
column5: Two rows of the same wide beach banner. An amber dashed square appears over the centre and everything outside it fades to white. The cropped square then slides out to the right: in the top row the person is centred, so the square holds the whole figure, with a green border and ✓ "subject centred"; in the bottom row the person is off to the left, so the square cuts them in half, with a red border and ✕ "subject off to one side". Labels "banner 2.35 : 1" and "square 1 : 1" sit above.

column3: Avatar (アイコン画像)
column5: Two rows, each starting from a square picture. A circular mask fades the outside to white and an amber dashed circle appears. Then round icons at 64, 32 and 16 px appear one after another. In the top row the face is centred on a plain background, so it still reads as a person at 16 px (✓); in the bottom row the face sits off to the right against a busy street scene and turns into an unreadable blob when shrunk (✕).

column3: Douyin vertical first frame (抖音の縦型ファーストフレーム)
column5: A 9:16 phone in the centre shows a full beach picture. Generic grey blocks for the right-hand buttons, the bottom caption and the top bar cover it one after another, and finally the central safe zone is outlined in blue dashes and labelled "safe zone". Two smaller phones then appear for comparison: on the left the person is inside the safe zone (✓); on the right the person stands at the bottom right, hidden by the buttons and caption (✕). No real app logos or buttons are drawn.

column3: Xiaohongshu cover (小紅書のカバー)
column5: The 3:4 cover first appears large on its own: a person standing on the beach, with the title "Beach weekend" and a small red subtitle in a white band at the top. An amber dashed box marks the "title area" and a bracket on the right says "subject over half". Then a grey 2-column feed appears and the cover shrinks into its top-left slot; next to the other grey covers its title is still readable. ✓ "shrunk into the 2-column feed · title still readable".

column3: Wallpaper (壁紙)
column5: The phone screen shows a pale-blue sky, layered hills and a person standing in front of them. The lock-screen date, a large "09:41" clock, then 2 round buttons and a bar at the bottom appear in turn. Next a white dashed box marks the clock and an amber dashed box the person, with leader lines to "time area" and "subject", and ✓ "keep the time and icon areas clear · subject low and centre". A smaller phone on the right is the counter-example: the person is placed high and is crushed under the big clock (✕).

column3: Livestream background (ライブ配信の背景)
column5: A sharp room appears first: bookshelves on both sides, a plant and a window in the middle. The background then darkens and blurs a step. The host's silhouette rises from below into the centre and a product box appears beside them. Finally white brand-info blocks appear at shoulder height on the left and right. A checklist on the right, "darken and blur the background a step", "host and product into the central space", "brand info at shoulder height on both sides", lights up step by step.

column3: Cinematic look (シネマ風)
column4: cinematic,letterbox,motivated light,shallow depth of field,teal and orange,color grading
column5: A plain daytime picture of a person in front of a café window on a street corner gains one ingredient at a time. First black bars close in top and bottom to make a wide frame. Then the window on the right glows warm, the scene turns to night, and the window light falls on the floor and the right side of the face. Next the buildings and window behind blur and the 4 street lamps swell into bokeh discs. Finally the whole frame sinks into teal, with orange pushed up only around the window. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: High-end look (高級感)
column5: It starts with a perfume bottle among flowers and a ribbon, on a background of 4 loud stripes. First the colours drop to muted beige tones. Then the flowers and ribbon disappear and the bottle shrinks and moves right, leaving space around it. Next a large soft light comes in from the left, a faint blurred shadow stretches to the right of the bottle and the right side of the frame darkens gently. Finally a liquid line, a vertical highlight on the glass and fine grooves on the metal cap appear. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Atmospheric mood (空気感)
column5: It starts from a plain picture of a person standing on a forest path lined with 8 trunks. First haze fills the air, thickest near the horizon, whitening the farther trees most. Then the sun behind the trees lights up and 6 beams cut through the haze, swaying slowly from side to side. Next the whole picture shifts cool, with warm colour left only around the sun. Finally the edges and bottom sink into shadow, so the beams in the middle stand out. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Loneliness (孤独感)
column5: It starts close on a person standing near a bench on a platform. First the view pulls back and the person becomes small inside a long platform of pillars and roof. Then the surroundings fall dark and only the cone of light from 1 lamp lights him and the floor at his feet. Next the colours turn to a blue-grey night. Finally the camera keeps backing away very slowly and the figure gets smaller still. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Ambient lighting (間接照明の雰囲気)
column4: ambient light,led strip,desk lamp,screen glow,low key,interior
column5: It starts from an ordinary, evenly lit bedroom: a bed corner, a poster, a desk with a monitor and a desk lamp. First the main light goes off and the whole room darkens. Then a purple-blue LED strip lights up near the ceiling and bleeds downward. Next the desk lamp comes on and drops a warm cone of light on the desk. Finally the monitor glows cold blue, spilling blue light around it and onto the desk, leaving only one warm and one cold local light. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Tactile texture (質感)
column5: It starts from a plain picture of a ceramic cup on a table. First the camera moves in and the cup grows large. Then a low light from the left makes the left side bright and the right dark; the surface grains pop out, each lit on the upper left with a small shadow on the lower right, and a long shadow stretches across the table. Next a soft, blurred vertical highlight appears on the left. Finally 3 fine scratches show up as dark lines with light edges. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Dreamy look (ドリーミー)
column5: It starts from a plain daytime picture of a person, head and shoulders, among flowers. First the sun appears behind them and a bright line traces the edge of the head and shoulder. Then the brightness around the sun blooms outward and small points of light on the flowers twinkle. Next the 4 near flowers grow and blur into soft blobs of colour. Finally the whole palette moves to pink, lavender and cream. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Clean look (すっきり)
column5: It starts with a desk scattered with small items, things stuck all over the wall and 3 patches of differently coloured light. First the 7 items on the desk disappear, leaving only the laptop, cup and plant. Then the 4 things on the wall go and the wall and floor brighten and recede. Next the coloured light patches fade and an even soft light covers everything. Finally the colours settle into one pale grey tone. The 3 kept items never change position or size. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Healing vibe (癒やし)
column5: It starts from a plain, cool-toned picture of a steaming cup of tea on a windowsill. First the window turns warm, low sunlight slants across the sill and the cup throws a long shadow. Then a striped blanket slides in from the bottom left. Next a warm white wash lowers the contrast and fine grain flickers over it. Finally the camera pushes in very slowly towards the cup. The steam sways the whole time. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Japanese airy look (日本風の透明感)
column5: It starts from a plain, contrasty picture of a person cycling along a seaside road under sky and sea. The road dashes stream past and the pedals keep turning. First the shadows lift and the blacks turn grey-blue. Then a backlight glows behind and above the rider and a bright line appears along their outline. Next everything leans towards green-cyan. Finally a thin whitish veil lowers the contrast, leaving a bright, pale finished look. A checklist on the right turns each numbered circle blue as its ingredient arrives, and the status reads plain version → adding → finished.

column3: Inpainting brief (部分修正)
column5: A photo of a person holding a white porcelain cup in their left hand, in a room with a picture frame on the wall and a light source at the top left. First a blue dashed box appears around the cup, its dashes marching, with "only change inside the box" beneath. Then, sweeping from left to right inside the box only, the cup is repainted into a red glass cup with a bright liquid line and a vertical highlight on its left. Finally a dashed amber arrow runs from the light at the top left to the new cup's highlight, tagged "light matches". The face, pose and background outside the box never change.

column3: Flat vector motion (フラット・ベクター)
column5: A coral dot drops from an ultramarine sky and hops 5 times; each landing springs up flat coloured buildings, then a wordmark bounces in.

column3: Line art animation (ラインアート)
column5: The camera follows a glowing pen tip as a gold line draws sprouts and towers in one stroke, then pulls back as the ring fills with gold.

column3: Morphing (シェイプモーフ)
column5: The main shape squeezes back to a circle before opening into the next form, wobbling as it turns, while the background wipes in a new colour and the caption swaps.

column3: Cel animation / line boil (手描きアニメ・線のゆらぎ)
column5: A match-flame sprite squashes and bounces, smoke puffs rise and star sparks pop, while the hand-lettered yellow HAND MADE keeps boiling.

column3: Isometric 2.5D (アイソメトリック 2.5D)
column5: On a lavender floating island, shadows land first, then pastel buildings spring up one after another, roofs drop on, windows light and data pulses between towers.

column3: 3D render look (3D レンダー調)
column5: Soft 3D letters drop in turn, squash and spring back, a chrome ball lands as the full stop, and a row of glossy pills ripples with each landing.

column3: Liquid motion (リキッドモーション)
column5: Drops bulge out of the top band, neck and break free, a small droplet follows, and each splashes flat into the pool below.

column3: Aurora gradient & glass (オーロラグラデーション・グラス)
column5: Aurora glows flow slowly over a dark background, 2 glass cards bob gently, chat lines appear one by one, and a glass lens sweeps back and forth magnifying the scene.

column3: Collage / cutout (コラージュ・切り絵)
column5: A cut-out head slaps onto kraft paper, its scalp flips open like a lid, stars, a rocket and a swallow fly out, and letter blocks and a torn banner are pasted on in turn.

column3: Bold-outline sticker explainer (太線ステッカー解説)
column5: A phone sticker slaps down with a bounce and callout lines draw out; the camera flies to a periodic table that lights up in a cascade, then to a chart that grows bar by bar.

column3: Variety-show captions (バラエティ番組のテロップ)
column5: Over a ginger cat, captions spring in letter by letter and sway, question marks hop and a sweat drop slides, then the camera punches in, a burst bubble and speed lines pop and a red stamp lands.

column3: Constructivist (構成主義)
column5: On a tilted cream canvas a red circle swells, then black bars, bold FORWARD and a red wedge slam in one after another, and later leave in reverse.

column3: Memphis (メンフィス)
column5: Circles, triangles, squiggles, dot grids and bars bob up and down across a peach ground, each spinning its own way.

column3: Art Deco (アール・デコ)
column5: Gold rays and fan arcs spread layer by layer from the bottom centre of a black field, framed by stepped arches, as a warm band of light sweeps across.

column3: Geometric / Bauhaus (幾何構成・バウハウス)
column5: On gridded paper, each beat adds a move — a red circle drops, a black bar pulls down, a triangle flips, a square grows from a corner — until BAUHAUS cuts in.

column3: Glitch (グリッチ)
column5: SIGNAL LOST splits into RGB ghosts on a dark poster while horizontal slices jump sideways under coloured noise bars and scanlines.

column3: Cyberpunk HUD / FUI (サイバーパンク HUD)
column5: Cyan frames, radar and globe light up in layers, readouts scramble then settle, brackets fly in, hunt and snap onto the target, and the lock flips everything magenta.

column3: 80s Synthwave / VHS (80s シンセウェイブ・VHS)
column5: A striped sun sits behind wireframe mountains, a magenta grid rolls toward camera and palms whip past; a chrome title slams down with a white flash and a neon script flickers on.

column3: Pixel art / 8-bit (ピクセルアート)
column5: A red-hooded hero runs across 3 parallax layers, jumps for coins and squashes a slime, while a blocky pixel logo drops in frame by frame and bounces.

column3: Risograph (リソグラフ)
column5: Pink and teal circles, squares and heavy type overlap on cream paper into a third colour, while the plates drift slightly back and forth.

column3: Glass mosaic (ガラスモザイク)
column5: Coloured glass tiles flip over in a wave from right to left to form a sunset over the sea, hold, then flip away again from the right.

column3: Spirograph (スピログラフ)
column5: Translucent gears roll around 3 rings on cream paper in turn, their pen tips tracing red, blue and green rosettes that close and hold.

column3: Guilloche (彩紋（ギョーシェ）)
column5: An emerald-and-gold rosette turns slowly with layers rotating in opposite directions, while wavy bands on both sides drift sideways.

column3: Seigaiha waves (青海波)
column5: Cream and indigo concentric arcs overlap like scales and slide slowly downward, under a still golden moon at the top right.

column3: Girih stars (ギリ星文様)
column5: Turquoise tiles with cobalt eight-point stars light up one by one outward from the centre on dark navy, each star scaling open.

column3: Fair Isle knit (フェアアイル編み)
column5: Plump V stitches appear row by row from the bottom, each row running back and forth, building bands of lattice, snowflake and reindeer motifs.

column3: Dry brush (書の筆致)
column5: A brush writes 永 stroke by stroke on rice paper with streaky dry edges; a red seal then shrinks into place, holds, and fades away.

column3: Vertical verse (縦書きの詩箋)
column5: On paper ruled in red, Wang Wei's poem fades in column by column from the right with varied ink depth, and a red seal is stamped at the end.

column2: East Asian tradition / Objects & folk crafts
column3: Blue & white (青花の皿)
column5: A white porcelain plate ringed with waves, lotus petals and scrolling vines turns slowly as a warm gold band of light crosses the glaze.

column3: Halftone (ハーフトーン)
column5: On cream paper, a ball and the 2 big words HALF and TONE are made entirely of dots. As the light circles the ball, dots on the lit side shrink and dots on the shadow side grow, so the shading turns smoothly around it. A bright band moves left to right across the words. Partway through, the dots split into cyan, magenta, yellow and black plates, overlapping at different angles to turn the ball red and the words blue, then they go back to black dots only.

column3: Low poly (ローポリ)
column5: Three mountains, the pines along the shore and a raft on the lake are all built from a handful of triangles, each a single shade. The light swings around horizontally along with a hexagonal sun at the top right; each face's brightness comes from its facing against the light and is quantised into a few steps, so as the light turns, the facets flip lighter and darker one by one. The lake mirrors the mountains, darkened and broken by horizontal ripples.

column3: Pop art (ポップアート)
column5: A steaming bowl of noodles fills the frame, drawn with thick black outlines, red and yellow rays behind it, and halftone dots in the background and on the bowl's shadow side that grow larger towards the edges. The bowl has a red oval pattern and no brand text. Chopsticks lift the noodles and lower them again. Then the picture shrinks into the top-left panel, the other 3 panels pop out one by one, and each of the 4 switches to its own bold colour scheme. Finally they retract in reverse order and it becomes a single picture again.

column3: Ukiyo-e (浮世絵)
column5: In the rain a big wooden bridge spans the frame, and 2 people with umbrellas walk across it in opposite directions, passing each other. Outlines are in ink with a few flat colours on top, printed slightly off-register from the line. The top of the sky and the bottom of the water use graded printing; the distant hills are flat grey-blue with no outline. Rain falls as fine cut lines at a fixed angle, rings spread on the water, and a foreground pine branch cuts off the top-right corner.

column3: Woodcut (木版画（白黒）)
column5: Only 2 colours, black and paper. The sky is rows of parallel black gouge lines that thicken towards the top, with the sun cut away completely. The sea is a big black mass; spray and currents are white cuts that follow the wave shapes, and the crests are upturned triangular nicks. A fisherman in a straw hat (no face drawn) leans back on the rocking boat and hauls up a net, showing the fish inside. Gulls flap overhead. Wood grain shows faintly in the black and coarse paper texture sits over everything.

column3: Embroidery (刺繍)
column5: Cream silk is stretched on a wooden hoop and a needle stitches a lotus leaf, flower, bud and a mandarin duck one stitch at a time. Petals and leaves use fishbone stitch running diagonally from the midrib to the edge, the lotus pad uses radiating long-and-short stitch, and the duck uses parallel satin stitch following its feathers. Each stitch shades from dark to light, and its brightness depends on its angle to the light, so the same thread gleams differently by direction. A shadow under every stitch shows the raised thread. When the stitching is done the needle leaves and a diagonal gleam sweeps across.

column3: Stained glass (ステンドグラス)
column5: An arched window in a dark stone wall shows a phoenix, a rose bush and a sun behind distant hills in stained glass. Every piece is edged with a thick black lead line and has its own shading and bubbles. The light behind it rises from below the window to the sun's position, and the pieces nearest the light turn from dark to glowing first. Bright glass gives off a glow, and on the floor below the window lies a stretched, upside-down patch of coloured light that shortens as the light climbs.

column3: Blue-green landscape (青緑山水)
column5: A silk handscroll pans slowly sideways, its far, middle and near mountain layers moving at different speeds. Each mountain is a cluster, a main peak flanked by smaller ones, with rounded tops and steep sides. At first there are only ink outlines and hemp-fibre texture strokes; then azurite and malachite wash down from the top, with ochre at the feet. Moss dots and small pines line the ridges, a little pavilion sits on a middle-ground peak, cloud bands drift at the mountains' feet, a stone bridge with a figure crosses a near valley, and a small boat floats on the river. At the end the colour drains back to bare ink.

column2: East Asian tradition / Objects & folk crafts
column3: Chinese paper cutting (中国の切り紙)
column5: A knife carves a folded half-circle of red paper cut by cut, from the top down; the pattern appears where it has cut and the rest is still plain red. Then the paper opens into a round, symmetric window flower: a sawtooth border, 2 plump carp facing each other head-up on either side, a lotus kept as outlines with its seed pod in the middle, lotus leaves and waves below, and curling cloud motifs filling the gaps. The scales are rows of crescent cut-outs, and every red line connects. The background is cream paper with a faint shadow under the cut.

column2: East Asian tradition / Objects & folk crafts
column3: Shadow puppets (影絵人形)
column5: Warm yellow light shines through a white screen where 2 shadow puppets face each other in profile. On the left is a tall, slender lady with a high bun and hairpins, a 3-tiered skirt and long translucent silk sleeves; on the right a general rides a horse whose body is one continuous curve, with each leg in 2 segments. Every part is filled with translucent colour and carved inside with fine dots, crescents and diamonds, with a bright cut-out line along its edge, rivets at the joints and rods attached to the hands and bodies. The lady raises her arm and flicks her sleeve, the horse marks time and the general bobs with it. A slightly blurred pavilion shadow stands at the left and the light flickers faintly.

column3: Chalkboard lesson (黒板とチョーク)
column5: Chalk draws a right triangle and the squares on its sides, labels a², b², c², rings c² in red and underlines the yellow formula twice; then an eraser wipes left to right.

column3: Blueprint drawing (青図の特許図面)
column5: Dashed construction lines appear on grid paper, the flange's front and side views draw in order, dimensions and a FIG. 1 title block follow, and a red pencil rings the bore and notes a tolerance; the sheet then rolls away upward.

column3: Dark math explainer (ダークな数学解説)
column5: On black, axes grow from the origin, ticks light up in turn and y = sin x rises letter by letter; a blue curve traces left to right with a gold dot and tangent riding it, turning red where the slope hits 0; then everything dims out.

column3: Metro map (地下鉄路線図)
column5: On white, red Line 1 grows and pauses at each station, which pops in on arrival; 博物馆 greys out with a closed tag, a yellow interchange branch draws at 市中心, and a train runs from 火车站 to 机场 before the map fades out.

column3: Isotype chart (アイソタイプ統計)
column5: On beige paper, person icons stamp down one by one into three rows while the number at each row's end counts up; the largest row, A 城, turns red with a 最多 tag, then the icons lift away from right to left.

column3: Ink-circle minimal (余白のミニマル)
column5: One brush stroke draws an ink circle on warm white paper, breaking into dry-brush streaks at the end; 静 appears inside, and 心不动，则万物静 writes in below one character at a time. Then the ink pales and the circle unwinds from its end.

column3: Keynote number (発表会ミニマル)
column5: On black, the grey heading 续航 fades in and a huge white number rolls from 0 to 32, landing with a small bounce; 小时 slides in beside it and a gradient bar lights up from the left beneath. Then the screen slowly fades to black.

column3: Starfield spark (星空の光点)
column5: Under a twinkling sky a gold spark rises and traces a glowing light-bulb outline; the bulb fades, the spark splits into 7 that drift apart and link into a constellation. Then the links break and the sparks gather into one and sink.

column3: Dark gold line art (ダークゴールドの線画)
column5: With a fixed camera, glowing amber lines on charcoal draw the floor, desk, chair, a person reading, an open book and a lamp in turn; the lamp flickers twice and comes on, casting a warm pool on the desk, and a page turns. Then the lines retract in reverse order and the light goes out.

column3: Clay kawaii (ねんどカワイイ)
column5: On a pink floor a milk-tea stand, a cup and three bean characters pop in one after another with a squash and bounce, and blink; the cup arcs over to the first bean, who smiles and hops twice. Then everything squashes flat into the floor.

column3: Magazine editorial (雑誌エディトリアル)
column5: On warm white paper the masthead rule draws out from the centre and the serif headline 慢生活 drops in; two columns of grey text bars set line by line, a right-hand paragraph turns into a large italic pull quote with a red rule on its left, and a page number appears bottom right. Then the whole page turns away to the left, revealing a blank next page.

column3: Silent-film title card (サイレント映画の字幕カード)
column5: An iris opens from black on a sepia station: a silhouette train rolls in from the right, slows and stops, puffing smoke. It cuts to a black intertitle with a double border and corner flourishes reading 终于到了！, then back to the platform, where a passenger in a top hat walks off with a suitcase. Grain, flicker, scratches and jitter run throughout; at the end the iris closes to a black dot.

column3: RPG dialogue box (RPG の会話ウィンドウ)
column5: In a pixel-art meadow at dusk, the hero stands at a merchant's stall. The dialogue window opens under a 商人 name tag and 要买药草吗？ types out with a cursor, then ▼ blinks. A 买 / 不买 menu pops up; the cursor moves to 不买, back to 买, and confirms. Gold goes from 50 to 40 with a floating −10, followed by 谢谢惠顾！. Then the window closes and the scene coarsens into big pixels and fades out.

column3: Card battle (カードバトル)
column5: On green felt, 骑士 and 巨龙 arc out of the deck on the left, flipping face up as they land. The knight rams but is blocked: MISS. The dragon counter-rams, a −5 pops over the knight, its card shakes and its HP bar drops from 8 to 3. Finally both cards flip back and fly home to the deck.

column3: Swiss grid kinetic type (スイスグリッドのタイポ)
column5: Grid lines for 12 columns fade in from left to right on off-white. Huge black letters G, R, I, D slam down one at a time, their left edges locked to column lines, then 2026 pushes in from the left on the next row. A red block rises from below and slides and stretches between columns, and the small date and venue text settles left-aligned on column 8. Finally type and block slide off to the right along the grid.

column3: Cut-paper title sequence (切り絵のタイトルバック)
column5: On vermilion, black building shapes slice in from the left, right and below one after another to form a city skyline, with window slits cut into them. A black vertical line splits the frame top to bottom, the characters 夜 and 行 cut in on either side, then small credits for director, cast and English title follow. Finally the type exits left and the shapes slice back out the way they came, leaving plain vermilion.

column3: Neon cyber (ネオンサイバー)
column5: A purple night alley with slanting rain. The sign's frame tubes flicker on one side at a time, then 24H, 拉, 面 and 营业中 power up in turn. Afterwards 面 keeps dropping out now and then, splitting into red and cyan. The wet ground holds a squashed reflection of the sign. Finally the power cuts and the tubes go dark one by one in reverse order.

column3: Retro desktop (レトロデスクトップ)
column5: A dithered gray desktop. The window 日记.txt opens with dotted zoom frames and two lines are typed one character at a time. The cursor clicks 文件, a menu drops down and 保存 highlights. A save dialog opens, its progress bar fills in steps and reads 已保存. The dialog closes and the file icon drops onto the desktop in jerky steps, flashing once. Finally the window shrinks shut through dotted frames and the icon blinks away.

column3: Cozy farm pixel (のんびり農場ピクセル)
column5: A fenced green farm seen from above. The wooden HUD at top right ticks the clock forward 10 minutes at a time from 6:00. The farmer walks the path and waters 5 columns in turn, darkening the soil. The crops grow through 3 stages: sprout, leaves and ripe pumpkin. The farmer comes back and harvests column by column, +5 floats up and today's income rises. Finally a night blue covers the scene, and when it lifts it is 6:00 again with seeds in the ground.

column3: Ransom-note cutouts (切り抜き文字)
column5: Gray newsprint with ruled lines and copier grain. The first line 全场五折 is pasted one character at a time, each shrinking into place, then the second line 仅限今天 follows. Every character has its own font, background, size and tilt. Two staples punch in along the top, and a red pen loops a hand-drawn oval around the first line. Finally everything fades, leaving the bare newsprint.

column3: National park poster (国立公園ポスター)
column5: A sheet of beige paper on a dark brown wall. Six plates – sky, far peaks, near hills, lake, pines and title band – press up from below in turn, each slightly off register. The swatches on the right light up as each ink is printed. Finally the sun rises from behind the far peaks. On reset the plates lift off from the top one down, back to blank paper.

column3: Bullet journal (手帳デコ)
column5: On dot-grid paper three strips of washi tape are pulled out and stuck down. A marker writes 本周计划 and a highlighter swipes under it. Three to-do lines are written one by one, and a blue ballpoint ticks them off in turn. A yellow sticky note reading 别忘了 喝水！ bounces on, and a doodled star is added last. On reset the note peels away and the writing and tape fade.

column3: Hand-drawn process (手描きプロセス)
column5: On white paper a pencil comes in from off-screen. It roughs out the saucer, cup, handle and steam in thin gray lines, then swaps for a black fineliner and traces the same strokes in ink, lifting slightly as it hops between lines. At each swap the old tool shrinks away and the new one drops in. A red marker then fills the cup with back-and-forth strokes, the fineliner returns to sign at the bottom right, and the tool leaves the frame. On reset a fresh page turns over from the right, back to blank paper.

column3: Ink wash on paper (水墨紙本)
column5: Xuan paper with visible fibres. The far hills bleed in pale, and nearer hills overlap a shade darker. Faint horizontal strokes mark the water, and a rock at the lower left is laid down in a single bold stroke. A small boat with a figure holding a pole drifts slowly from left to right. At the top right the vertical inscription 孤舟一叶 远山青 appears one character at a time, and a vermilion seal is pressed last. On reset the ink spreads and fades, and the paper turns clean again.

column3: Gufeng (古風)
column5: A dusk sky shading from indigo to orange, with a warm moon. The vermilion gate tower glows through its lattice windows and gateway, with a crowd silhouetted in front. Red lanterns on a rope light one by one from the left and sway, the glow in front of the tower grows, and sky lanterns drift up. A vermilion seal 灯会 stamps down at top left, and a gold 1120 年 floats up at right. On reset the lanterns go out in turn and the seal and numerals fade.

column3: TV news package (テレビニュース)
column5: A blue studio with light shafts and a slowly turning wireframe globe. The channel bug 晨光新闻 comes in at top left, with a blinking 直播 badge and the time at top right. A picture-in-picture pops open on the right as a subway train pulls into the platform. A headline bar tagged 最新 and a detail bar slide in from the left, while the ticker at the bottom keeps scrolling. Midway a red 突发 banner sweeps across. On reset the bars, the picture-in-picture and the bug retract in turn and the studio lights fade.

column3: Caption news (字幕ニュース)
column5: Night-street bokeh drifts sideways on a dark screen. A yellow rule grows down the left and 外卖平均 types in character by character. A huge number rolls from 0 to 28 and lands, while a yellow arc on the timer ring at right grows with it. A yellow block wipes across 28 分钟 from the left, flipping the text inside it to black. A follow-up line types in, and a small source credit slides up from below. On reset the whole caption moves up out of frame.

column3: Visual investigation (ビジュアル調査)
column5: Three panels sit on a dark gray desk: a newspaper clipping on the left, a riverside scene with a clock tower in the middle, and a 1920–1945 timeline on the right. A yellow highlighter runs over 钟楼刚刚落成, and a red pen loops a hand-drawn ellipse around the clock tower. The timeline cursor slides from 1920 and stops at 1934 钟楼落成, which lights up. The camera pushes in on the red circle, corner brackets appear, and a red-framed stamp 推定：1934 年 lands. On reset the marks and highlight wipe away and the camera pulls back.

column3: Archive light table (アーカイブ・ライトテーブル)
column5: In a darkroom the light table flickers on like a fluorescent tube. An amber film strip goes down, then three bamboo slips one by one from above. A loupe arcs from beside the film to the slips and stops over 年 on the third slip. Inside the lens everything is magnified 2.2 times; a red pen circles the character in one stroke and a numbered tag 关键字「年」 is stuck beside it. On reset the table goes dark and everything lifts up out of frame.

column3: Copperplate botanical (銅版博物画)
column5: A double-ruled plate on foxed old paper. A fine ink stem grows, four toothed basal leaves are drawn, and the flower head and the downy seed ball open out radially. 45° hatching sweeps from top left to bottom right across the leaves and the flower centre, and a beat later a pale green and yellow wash seeps out from the centres. Red part numbers 1–3 appear, and on the left PL. XII, 蒲公英, the Latin name and three caption lines come in one by one. On reset the wash fades, then the hatching and ink lines retract to a blank plate.

column3: Handscroll (絵巻)
column5: On a dark brown desk the left roller rolls away from the right one and the scroll opens. A pale blue river with a small boat, an arched bridge, gray-blue-roofed shops, a wine banner, willows and passers-by appear in line and wash. A vertical title slip 市井图卷 goes on at the head of the scroll and a red seal is stamped. A loupe moves from top right to a porter carrying a shoulder pole on the bridge, magnifying him 2.4 times. On reset the loupe goes away and the left roller rolls back to the right, closing the scroll.

column3: Dunhuang mural (敦煌壁画)
column5: A wall covered in ochre plaster. Cracked plaster pieces fall one by one in shuffled order, tumbling and fading, to reveal red ochre beneath. A haloed apsara flies left holding a lotus, her whole body bobbing gently. Her hair is piled in a high double-loop bun with a gold floral crown, her malachite skirt trails behind in three S-curved tails, slender legs with pointed toes curl out from under it, and three streamers ripple in wide S-curves. Scrolling clouds and falling petals fill in, and a diagonal glint runs twice across the gold-framed cartouche 飞天 at top left. On reset the plaster covers back over from the edges inward.

column3: Ballpoint hatching (ボールペンのハッチング)
column5: A mug in blue ink on lined notebook paper. The outline goes down first, then hatching on the right side, cross-hatching on top of it, and finally a hatched shadow.

column3: Coloured pencil (色鉛筆)
column5: An apple on cream paper. Diagonal strokes go down in yellow, orange and deep red, cross-hatching darkens the shadow, and the stem and leaf come last. The paper's tooth stays as white specks.

column3: Wax crayon (クレヨン)
column5: A red balloon in crayon. Back-and-forth strokes fill it with white flecks of paper left behind; dark red adds shade, white a highlight, then a fat outline goes round twice and the string is drawn.

column3: Charcoal and eraser (木炭と練り消し)
column5: Charcoal goes on in vertical strokes and is smudged, then a pear and the light of a window are erased out of it. The outlines and window frame are redrawn on top, with a faint offset ghost of the earlier line.

column3: Pencil and watercolour (鉛筆と水彩)
column5: A five-petal flower is sketched in pencil; pale pink and green washes go on one patch at a time, a deeper second wash follows, and pencil details finish the centre.

column3: Ink line and wash (ペン画と淡彩)
column5: A small bird on a branch. Brown, cream and branch-coloured washes bloom one at a time with backruns at their edges; then ink lines draw the body, head, tail, beak, branch, legs and wing, and the eye is dotted in last.

column3: Oil impasto (油彩の厚塗り)
column5: A still life of a bottle and a pear on linen. Background, table, bottle and pear are blocked in thinly in that order, thick dabs build on top, and near-white highlights go on the side facing the top-left light.

column3: Broken colour (筆触分割)
column5: A sunset over water. Short dabs in blue-violet, orange-yellow, navy and pale blue go down row by row from the top, with a band of reflected light under the sun; the sun itself is dabbed in last in pale yellows.

column3: Mid-century gouache (ミッドセンチュリーのガッシュ)
column5: A simplified city scene. Ground, buildings, sun, cloud and tree appear as flat shapes one after another, with dry-brush edges and faint brush marks; the ink outlines and windows come last, shifted up and to the right of the colour.

column3: Stippling (点描)
column5: An egg and its shadow on cream paper. Dots go in from the darkest areas to the lightest, with the pen tip following the latest dot and fading away once it is done.

column3: Single-line engraving (一本線の彫版)
column5: Navy ink on cream paper. One spiral line runs out from the centre of a sphere, thin at the upper left and thick at the lower right, until a lit ball appears.

column3: Scratchboard (スクラッチボード)
column5: A moonlit night on black. The knife scrapes out the moon's outline, horizontal lines across it that skip the craters, then waves and stars, with the blade following the line it is cutting.

column3: Paper toy theatre (紙の人形劇場)
column5: On a dark stage a torn paper sky, a sun, far hills and near hills slide up one after another, then a red proscenium drops into place. Each paper casts a shadow, and the layers sway a little.

column3: Rubber-hose cartoon (ラバーホース・アニメ)
column5: A character with a white face and pie-cut eyes bounces 4 times on the spot. One arm rises as the other drops and its body squashes at every landing. Film grain, flickering brightness, an occasional vertical scratch and a vignette cover the frame.

column3: Toy bricks (おもちゃのブロック)
column5: On pale grey paper 8 bricks in red, blue, yellow, green and white drop in 0.5 s apart and stack into 5 layers. Each one bounces slightly as it lands, and the shadow on the floor spreads.
